name: Meftal Spas Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About MEFTAL SPAS TABLET

MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFTAL SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFTAL SPAS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFTAL SPAS TABLET Works

MEFTAL SPAS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFTAL SPAS TABLET

Take MEFTAL SPAS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFTAL SPAS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFTAL SPAS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFTAL SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFTAL SPAS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

faqs.question: Q: Can MEFTAL SPAS TABLET relieve period pain?
faqs.answer: A: Yes, MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is an anti-spasmolytic and analgesic that helps to relieve pain and cramps during mensuration. Consult your doctor regarding dose and duration of course of MEFTAL SPAS TABLET before taking it.

faqs.question: Q: Can I consume alcohol after taking MEFTAL SPAS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: No, avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MEFTAL SPAS TABLET because it might lead to complications such as increased gastrointestinal bleeding, ulceration and perforation.

faqs.question: Q: Is MEFTAL SPAS TABLET safe to use in pregnant women?
faqs.answer: A: MEFTAL SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy as it can cause heart defects in the fetus (premature closure of heart duct), delay in onset of labour and increased bleeding tendency in mother. Consult your doctor before taking it.

faqs.question: Q: Can I take antacid along with MEFTAL SPAS TABLET for stomach pain?
faqs.answer: A: No, antacids (such as magnesium hydroxide) can interfere with absorption of MEFTAL SPAS TABLET. Hence its advisable not take both medicines together. Consult your doctor before taking it.

faqs.question: Q: Can MEFTAL SPAS TABLET be used in patients with kidney problems?
faqs.answer: A: MEFTAL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with preexisting renal disease or obstructive uropathy or in patients with significantly impaired renal function. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: Spasmonil Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SPASMONIL TABLET

SPASMONIL TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking SPASMONIL TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. SPASMONIL TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

SPASMONIL TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

SPASMONIL TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. SPASMONIL TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. SPASMONIL TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. SPASMONIL TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SPASMONIL TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMONIL TABLET Works

SPASMONIL TABLET is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

introduction:
Introduction About NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE

NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE

It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps or spasms in adult patients with:

Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)
Chronic irritable colon
Spastic constipation
Mucous colitis
Spastic colitis
mechanismOfAction:
How NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE Works

NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE is an antispasmodic medication. It relaxes the smooth muscles of the stomach and the intestines which therefore relieves painful muscle cramps caused due to irritable bowel syndrome and other stomach conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE

Take NORMAXIN MB CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: BUSCOTAG P Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BUSCOTAG P TABLET

BUSCOTAG P TABLET is a combination of Hyoscine Butyl bromide and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics, Analgesics and Antipyretics respectively. It is used to relieve spasmodic pain such as pain and cramps in the muscles of the stomach (abdominal cramp), gut (intestine), bladder and urinary system.

Before taking BUSCOTAG P TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a fast heart rate or other heart problems, problems with the thyroid gland, difficulty or pain in passing water (urine) such as men with prostate problems, constipation and fever.

BUSCOTAG P TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. This medicine is not recommended for use in children (under 6 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking BUSCOTAG P TABLET are dry mouth, abnormal sweating and increased heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of BUSCOTAG P TABLET
Manage spasmodic pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BUSCOTAG P TABLET Works

BUSCOTAG P TABLET contains hyoscine butylbromide and paracetamol. Hyoscine butylbromide is an anticholinergic that works by relaxing the stomach and gut (intestine) muscles. It stops spasms (sudden muscle contractions), thereby relieving pain, cramps, bloating and discomfort. Paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic that works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain.
usageDetails:
How to use BUSCOTAG P TABLET

Take BUSCOTAG P TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your doctor for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Spadic 20mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About SPADIC 20MG TABLET

SPADIC 20MG TABLET contains a medicine called Dicyclomine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common condition that affects the digestive system. It causes symptoms like stomach cramps, bloating, diarrhoea and constipation.

Before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver, lungs or heart or if you have other conditions such as myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, glaucoma, an enlarged prostate or reflux esophagitis.

SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if advised by your doctor and it is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. In elderly patients (over the age of 65), SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used with caution. The most common side effects of taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET include dizziness, weakness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, sleepiness and nervousness. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPADIC 20MG TABLET
Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How SPADIC 20MG TABLET Works

SPADIC 20MG TABLET works by slowing the natural movements of the gut and by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and intestine, which helps to relieve cramps, pain, bloating, wind and discomfort.

How to use SPADIC 20MG TABLET

Take SPADIC 20MG TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition
sideEffects: Signs of allergic reactions (such as rash, swallowing or breathing problems, swelling of your face, lips, tongue or throat)

warnings.details: SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used during pregnancy only if considered necessary. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.
SPADIC 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, tiredness, sleepiness or blurred vision after taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.
SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.
SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver impairment. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.
Do not take SPADIC 20MG TABLET if you are allergic to Dicyclomine.

SPADIC 20MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with unstable cardiovascular status during acute hemorrhage. It should be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure, coronary heart disease, high blood pressure and a history of cardiac surgery. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.

Others

SPADIC 20MG TABLET is not recommended for you, if you have:

Glaucoma
Myasthenia gravis
Severe ulcerative colitis
Obstructive uropathy (flow of urine is blocked)
Obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, reflux esophagitis

Before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have:

Enlarged prostate
Indigestion or heartburn caused by hiatus hernia (part of the stomach pushes through the diaphragm)
Ulcerative colitis

Use in Pediatrics:

SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in children from 2 years of age and above. Consult the child’s doctor for advice on a suitable dose.

Use in Geriatrics:

SPADIC 20MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Usually, the dose will be initiated with the lowest effective dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor before taking SPADIC 20MG TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About MOREASE 135MG TABLET

MOREASE 135MG TABLET contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MOREASE 135MG TABLET 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MOREASE 135MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MOREASE 135MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MOREASE 135MG TABLET are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET

SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Abdominal pain

mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET Works

SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET

Take SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of SPASMONIL PLUS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM TABLET

CYCLOPAM TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CYCLOPAM TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. CYCLOPAM TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

CYCLOPAM TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

CYCLOPAM TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. CYCLOPAM TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. CYCLOPAM TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. CYCLOPAM TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking CYCLOPAM TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About DOVERIN 40MG TABLET

DOVERIN 40MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DOVERIN 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOVERIN 40MG TABLET Works

DOVERIN 40MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
It can be taken with or without food.

It is important not to exceed the recommended dose, and you should take it at the same time every day if it's prescribed regularly

name: Hyocimax MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HYOCIMAX MF TABLET

HYOCIMAX MF TABLET is a combination of Hyoscine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used to manage mensural pain and helps to reduce menstrual discomfort and cramps by relaxing the muscles of the stomach and gut.

HYOCIMAX MF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired kidney function and impaired liver function. HYOCIMAX MF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness and fatigue), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe gastritis and ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). Consult your doctor before taking.

HYOCIMAX MF TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant or those who are planning to get pregnant and breastfeeding women. It is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. The most common side effects of taking HYOCIMAX MF TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting dizziness, light-headedness. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen or persists for a longer duration.

How HYOCIMAX MF TABLET Works

HYOCIMAX MF TABLET is a combination of Hyoscine and Mefenamic acid. Hyoscine relaxes the muscles in the stomach and gut and stops sudden muscle contractions. It also relieves cramps, pain, bloating, and discomfort. Mefenamic acid is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) which works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain and inflammation (redness and swelling).

Introduction About DROTIN TABLET

DROTIN TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROTIN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How DROTIN TABLET Works

This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

Introduction About DROFEM TABLET

DROFEM TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation and migraine headache.

DROFEM TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROFEM TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DROFEM TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROFEM TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. DROFEM TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

name: Hyocimax S Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About HYOCIMAX S TABLET

HYOCIMAX S TABLET contains Hyoscyamine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergic agents. It is used to manage the symptoms of functional intestinal disorders such as mild dysentery and diverticulitis (infection of the intestinal pouches). It is also used to control gastric secretion, spasms in internal organs and increased contractions and abdominal cramps associated with conditions such as cystitis (inflammation of the urinary bladder) and pylorospasm (abnormal contraction of the lower part of the stomach).

It is also used to provide symptomatic relief from biliary colic (blockade of the gall bladder duct), renal colic (pain in the kidney) and the common cold when used with appropriate analgesics. It is also used as adjunctive therapy to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome, acute enterocolitis (inflammation of the digestive tract) and other functional gastrointestinal disorders in affected individuals.

Functional intestinal disorders are common disorders that are generally characterised by persistent and recurring gastrointestinal symptoms such as abdominal pain, an inability to swallow and indigestion. A peptic ulcer is a condition that occurs when stomach acid damages the lining of the digestive tract. It is generally characterised by symptoms such as a burning sensation in the stomach, bloating and/or heartburn. Irritable bowel syndrome is a common disorder that affects the large intestine and is characterised by symptoms such as abdominal cramping, diarrhoea, constipation and bloating in affected individuals.

Before starting management with HYOCIMAX S TABLET, your doctor might advise you to take an echocardiogram (ECG) to access your heart rate. HYOCIMAX S TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), obstructive uropathy (hindered urine flow), myasthenia gravis (weak muscles), unstable cardiovascular status or myocardial ischemia.

Before taking HYOCIMAX S TABLET, inform your doctor if you have undergone an ileostomy (surgical removal of the ileum) or colostomy (surgical removal of the colon), a hiatal hernia associated with reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of the oesophagus followed by acid reflux) and coronary heart disease or congestive heart failure.

HYOCIMAX S TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women. It is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women and children (aged below 12 years). The most common side effects of taking HYOCIMAX S TABLET are dryness of the mouth & eyes, decreased sweating, headache, visual blurring, constipation, urinary retention and/or impotence. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms get worse.

Do not take HYOCIMAX S TABLET if you are allergic to hyoscyamine or other ingredients in this medicine.

HYOCIMAX S TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with unstable cardiovascular status and myocardial ischemia (reduced blood flow to the heart). HYOCIMAX S TABLET should be used with caution in patients with coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure and/or cardiac arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat). Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

HYOCIMAX S TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye)
Have obstructive uropathy (a condition marked by the hindrance of urine flow)
Have obstructive diseases of the gastrointestinal tract such as achalasia (difficulty in passing food from the oesophagus to the stomach), pyloroduodenal stenosis (obstruction in the stomach and intestine junction)
Have paralytic ileus (temporary paralysis of muscle contractions of the intestine)
Have intestinal atony (loss of muscle tone or strength of intestine), especially if you are an elderly or debilitated (weak) patient
Have severe ulcerative colitis (ulcers and inflammation of the intestine)
Have toxic megacolon (a severe complication of ulcerative colitis)
Have myasthenia gravis (autoimmune disorder causing severe muscle weakness)

Before taking HYOCIMAX S TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have undergone ileostomy (surgical removal of the ileum) or colostomy (surgical removal of the colon)
Have hiatal hernia associated with reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of oesophagus followed by acid reflux)
Have autonomic neuropathy (a condition causing damage to the nerves that control automatic body functions)
Have signs of hyperthyroidism (increased thyroid levels in the blood) such as unintentional weight loss, rapid heart rate

Use in Paediatrics:

HYOCIMAX S TABLET is not recommended for use in children (below 12 years of age). Consult your doctor before taking HYOCIMAX S TABLET.

Use in Geriatrics:

HYOCIMAX S TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Consult your doctor before taking HYOCIMAX S TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About TINNITOD CAPSULE

TINNITOD CAPSULE is used in the management of abdominal pain and tinnitus. It contains Caroverine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antispasmodic agents. TINNITOD CAPSULE works by blocking specific calcium channels and modifying neurotransmitter release in the nervous system. This helps in reducing abnormal nerve activity that leads to muscle spasms and protects the inner ear's nerve cells.

Before taking TINNITOD CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart disease. There are limited studies available for pregnant and breastfeeding women. TINNITOD CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, though taking it with food may reduce gastrointestinal side effects.

The most common side effects of TINNITOD CAPSULE are drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, upset stomach or rash, itching, or swelling (allergic reactions). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About ZERODOL SPAS TABLET

ZERODOL SPAS TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use ZERODOL SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking ZERODOL SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

ZERODOL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. ZERODOL SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking ZERODOL SPAS TABLET. The most common side effects of taking ZERODOL SPAS TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

Dysmenorrhea
Abdominal pain
Cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How ZERODOL SPAS TABLET Works

ZERODOL SPAS TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use ZERODOL SPAS TABLET

Always take ZERODOL SPAS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of ZERODOL SPAS TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ZERODOL SPAS TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About DROTIN DS TABLET

DROTIN DS TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROTIN DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIN DS TABLET Works

DROTIN DS TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

There are no adequate data on the use of Drotaverine in lactation women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Studies have shown that drotaverine can harm your kidneys. Therefore, this medicine is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing kidney conditions.
This medicine should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOBID TABLET

CYCLOBID TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking CYCLOBID TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. CYCLOBID TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

CYCLOBID TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

CYCLOBID TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. CYCLOBID TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. CYCLOBID TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. CYCLOBID TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking CYCLOBID TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)

CYCLOBID TABLET is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

Introduction About BELIC TABLET

BELIC TABLET is a combination of Hyoscine Butyl bromide and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics, Analgesics and Antipyretics respectively. It is used to relieve spasmodic pain such as pain and cramps in the muscles of the stomach (abdominal cramp), gut (intestine), bladder and urinary system.

Before taking BELIC TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a fast heart rate or other heart problems, problems with the thyroid gland, difficulty or pain in passing water (urine) such as men with prostate problems, constipation and fever.

BELIC TABLET is not recommended to use among pregnant and breastfeeding women. This medicine is not recommended for use in children (under 6 years of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking BELIC TABLET are dry mouth, abnormal sweating and increased heart rate. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

Manage spasmodic pain
mechanismOfAction:
How BELIC TABLET Works

BELIC TABLET contains hyoscine butylbromide and paracetamol. Hyoscine butylbromide is an anticholinergic that works by relaxing the stomach and gut (intestine) muscles. It stops spasms (sudden muscle contractions), thereby relieving pain, cramps, bloating and discomfort. Paracetamol is an analgesic and antipyretic that works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause pain.

How to use BELIC TABLET

Take BELIC TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. The correct dose and duration will be decided by your doctor for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Introduction About DROLGAN TABLET

DROLGAN TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use DROLGAN TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking DROLGAN TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

DROLGAN TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. DROLGAN TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking DROLGAN TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DROLGAN TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROLGAN TABLET Works

DROLGAN TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.

Always take DROLGAN TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DROLGAN TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DROLGAN TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About DVN 40MG TABLET

DVN 40MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DVN 40MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DVN 40MG TABLET Works

DVN 40MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

TAVERA M TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation, and migraine headache.

TAVERA M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

TAVERA M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. TAVERA M TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

TAVERA M TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. TAVERA M TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About COLIMEX TABLET

COLIMEX TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking COLIMEX TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. COLIMEX TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

COLIMEX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

COLIMEX TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. COLIMEX TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. COLIMEX TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. COLIMEX TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking COLIMEX TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIMEX TABLET Works

COLIMEX TABLET is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

Take COLIMEX TABLET as advised by your physician. With a glass of water, take the tablet. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Depending on your age, body weight, disease condition, your doctor will fix the correct dose and duration for you.

introduction:
Introduction About ANAFORTAN N TABLET

ANAFORTAN N TABLET is a combination of Camylofin and Nimesulide which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergic and Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used in the management of renal colic (pain when stone gets stuck in the urinary tract causing painful, bloody or cloudy urination), biliary colic (pain in the abdomen due to obstruction by stones in bile duct), intestinal colic (cramp like pain in the small or large intestine) and dysmenorrhea (period or menstrual cramps around the abdomen, hips, lower back).

Having a fiber rich diet, keeping yourself hydrated, quitting smoking and alcohol will help in the management process.

Before taking ANAFORTAN N TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, heart, prostate gland, thyroid gland, lung problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding disorder, bowel problems, having a surgery, glaucoma and fever.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during this management. ANAFORTAN N TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor for advice.

ANAFORTAN N TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age.

The most common side effects of taking ANAFORTAN N TABLET are nausea, vomiting, constipation, blurred vision and dry mouth. Consult your doctor if symptoms do not improve.

introduction:
Introduction About MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE

MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE

It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps or spasms in adult patients with:

Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)
Chronic irritable colon
Spastic constipation
Mucous colitis
Spastic colitis
mechanismOfAction:
How MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE Works

MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE is an antispasmodic medication. It relaxes the smooth muscles of the stomach and the intestines which therefore relieves painful muscle cramps caused due to irritable bowel syndrome and other stomach conditions.
usageDetails:
How to use MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE

Take MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.
sideEffects: Signs of allergic reaction (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat which causes difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Stop taking MEBIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE and contact your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects such as:

Signs of allergic reaction (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the face, lips, tongue or throat which causes difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

name: Spas Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About SPAS DROPS

SPAS DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Dimethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodic agents and Anti-foaming agents respectively. It is used for the management of functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome, gastric distension, functional digestive disorders and stomach pain in children.

Before giving SPAS DROPS inform your doctor if your child have diarrhea, ulcerative colitis, thyroid problems, hypertension, liver problems, kidney problems or heart problems, history of allergy, intolerance to any food products and abdominal obstruction.

Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. SPAS DROPS may cause your child to sweat less, increasing his or her risk of heatstroke. Avoid overheating by avoiding strenuous work or exercise in hot weather and using hot baths.

Give the prescribed dose to your child orally before a meal or as directed by the doctor. Do not abruptly stop the medicine by yourself as it may bring back the symptoms or worsen your child’s condition.

The most common side effects of this medicine are dryness in the mouth, dizziness, weakness, sleepiness, nervousness, blurred vision and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

If these side effects occur, they will subside once your child’s body adapts to the medicine. In case these side effects do not improve or become bothersome for your child, contact your doctor immediately.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPAS DROPS

It is used to manage:

Functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome
Gastric distension
Functional digestive disorders
Stomach pain
mechanismOfAction:
How SPAS DROPS Works

SPAS DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Dimethicone. Dicyclomine works by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and gut (intestine). It stops sudden contractions of the muscle (spasms), thereby relieving abdominal cramps and pain. Dimethicone works by disintegrating the gas bubbles and allowing easy passage of gas. Hence it helps to reduce the abdominal pain caused due to cramps, spasms and gas formation.
usageDetails:
How to use SPAS DROPS

Give SPAS DROPS to your child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Fever and heat stroke (due to decreased sweating)

name: Anafortan MF Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About ANAFORTAN MF TABLET

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is a combination of Camylofin and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodic and Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used to manage renal colic (pain when stone gets stuck in the urinary tract causing painful, bloody, or cloudy urination), biliary colic (pain in the abdomen due to obstruction by stones in bile duct), intestinal colic (cramp like pain in the small or large intestine) and dysmenorrhea (period or menstrual cramps around the abdomen, hips, lower back).

Having a fiber rich diet, keeping yourself hydrated, quitting smoking and alcohol will help in the management process. Prior to the management your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests. Before taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, heart, prostate gland, thyroid gland, lung problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding disorder, diabetes, cholesterol, bowel problems, systemic lupus erythematosus, having a surgery, glaucoma, fever, epilepsy or blood circulation problems.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with ANAFORTAN MF TABLET. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET are nausea, vomiting, heartburn, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects do not improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANAFORTAN MF TABLET

It is used to manage:

Renal colic
Biliary colic
Intestinal colic
Period cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How ANAFORTAN MF TABLET Works

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET works by relieving muscle cramps and pain in which Camylofin relaxes the muscles in the stomach and intestine stopping sudden muscle contractions (spasms). Mefenamic acid inhibits the enzyme cyclo-oxygenase and there by inhibits the synthesis of prostaglandins that cause inflammation (redness and swelling) and pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ANAFORTAN MF TABLET

Take ANAFORTAN MF TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Diarrhea, passing black tarry stools or vomiting blood

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET.
Do not drive or use machines while taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET as it may cause dizziness, drowsiness, fatigue and visual disturbances which may affect their ability to drive or operate machines.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET as it can increase the risk of stomach bleeding.

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease. ANAFORTAN MF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver disease. ANAFORTAN MF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with mild to moderate liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking.
Do not take ANAFORTAN MF TABLET if you are allergic to Camylofin, Mefenamic acid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ANAFORTAN MF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with obstructive airway disease, asthma and other lung disease. Consult your doctor before taking.

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had a heart bypass surgery, mechanical stenosis and other serious heart problems. ANAFORTAN MF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with previous stroke, heart failure, cardiac surgery, high blood pressure. Consult your doctor before taking.
ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. Consult your doctor before taking.

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age as they are more prone to side effects. If needed dose will be adjusted accordingly. Consult your doctor before taking ANAFORTAN MF TABLET.

Others

ANAFORTAN MF TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have glaucoma
Have gastrointestinal disorder like peptic ulcer, bleeding stomach or severe gastritis
Have prostatic hypertrophy
Inflammatory bowel disease (Ex. ulcerative colitis, crohn's disease)

Have thyroid gland problem
Have fever
Have diabetes
Have high cholesterol
Have bleeding disorder
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE) or mixed connective tissue disease
Have or had a surgery
Have epilepsy
Are dehydrated
Are intolerant to certain sugars

introduction:
Introduction About BIGSPAS P TABLET

BIGSPAS P TABLET is a combination of Camylofin and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodics, Analgesics and Antipyretics respectively. It is used in the management of abdominal pain and spasm associated with Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), spasms associated with diarrhea and dysentery, renal colic (pain when the stone gets stuck in the urinary tract causing painful, bloody, or cloudy urination), biliary colic (pain in the abdomen due to obstruction by stones in the bile duct), intestinal colic (cramp-like pain in the small or large intestine) and dysmenorrhea (period or menstrual cramps around the abdomen, hips, lower back).  

Having a fiber-rich diet, keeping yourself hydrated, and quitting smoking and alcohol will help in the management process. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests.

Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol during this management. BIGSPAS P TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have narrow-angle glaucoma, prostatic hypertrophy, mechanical stenoses, megacolon, GI hemorrhage, tachyarrhythmia, porphyria, and urinary retention.

Before taking BIGSPAS P TABLET inform your doctor if you have paralytic ileus, ulcerative colitis, pyloric stenosis, thyrotoxicosis, obstructive lung disease, liver problems, kidney problems, heart problems, fever, and hypertension.

BIGSPAS P TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. BIGSPAS P TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

It should be used with caution above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking BIGSPAS P TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dry mouth, giddiness, dilated pupil, skin rash, and fast heartbeat. Consult your doctor for advice if above side effects do not improve.

name: Drotin M Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About DROTIN M TABLET

DROTIN M TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation, and migraine headache.

DROTIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROTIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DROTIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROTIN M TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. DROTIN M TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIN M TABLET Works

DROTIN M TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).
usageDetails:
How to use DROTIN M TABLET

Take DROTIN M TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow DROTIN M TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse DROTIN M TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DROTIN M TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About MOREASE SR CAPSULE

MOREASE SR CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MOREASE SR CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MOREASE SR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MOREASE SR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MOREASE SR CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps or spasms in adult patients with:

name: NOBEL SPAS NEW Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET

NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET. The most common side effects of taking NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET

Manages,

Dysmenorrhea
Abdominal pain
Cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET Works

NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET

Always take NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NOBEL SPAS NEW TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

name: EPITAG PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About EPITAG PLUS TABLET

EPITAG PLUS TABLET is a combination of Eperisone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage pain due to muscle spasm.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it may severely damage the liver.  EPITAG PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver disease or disorder and kidney disease.

EPITAG PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. EPITAG PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety data and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking EPITAG PLUS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, abdominal pain, general discomfort and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
uses: Manage pain due to muscle spasm
usesDetails:
Uses Of EPITAG PLUS TABLET
Manage pain due to muscle spasm
mechanismOfAction:
How EPITAG PLUS TABLET Works

EPITAG PLUS TABLET helps to manage pain due to muscle spasm, where eperisone works by acting on the centres in the brain and spinal cord. It also dilates vascular smooth muscles improving blood flow and relieves muscle spasm. Paracetamol works by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes.
usageDetails:
How to use EPITAG PLUS TABLET

Take EPITAG PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow EPITAG PLUS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking EPITAG PLUS TABLET without informing your doctor.

Serious infection such as blood poisoning

introduction:
Introduction About COLOSPA 135MG TABLET

COLOSPA 135MG TABLET contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take COLOSPA 135MG TABLET 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking COLOSPA 135MG TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take COLOSPA 135MG TABLET if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking COLOSPA 135MG TABLET are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE

MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MEVA SR 200MG CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

name: Biospas Plus 10/250mg Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET

BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET Works

BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET

Take BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
