interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking BIOSPAS PLUS 10/250MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)

introduction:
Introduction About DOVERIN 80MG TABLET

DOVERIN 80MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DOVERIN 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOVERIN 80MG TABLET Works

DOVERIN 80MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation and migraine headache.

DROZIVER M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROZIVER M TABLET Works

DROZIVER M TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DROZIVER M TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

Introduction About DROZIVER 80MG TABLET

DROZIVER 80MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROZIVER 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How DROZIVER 80MG TABLET Works

DROZIVER 80MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

introduction:
Introduction About GASTRAZINE CAPSULE

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE contains Dicyclomine, Oxethazine, and Simethicone which belong to the group of medicines called antispasmodics, anaesthetics, and gastrointestinal agents (antifoaming agents) respectively. It is used in children and adults for the management of irritable bowel syndrome. Irritable bowel syndrome is a disorder of the large intestine with symptoms of stomach pain, muscle pain, excess gas, bloating, constipation, loose motion, etc. GASTRAZINE CAPSULE is also used to manage heartburn and acidity.

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE is not recommended for patients with myasthenia gravis (an autoimmune disease with muscle weakness), glaucoma, intestinal obstruction, gastrointestinal tract obstruction, blocked urine output (obstructive uropathy), severe ulcerative colitis (inflammation and ulcer in the digestive tract), food from the stomach entering back into the oesophagus (reflux oesophagitis), unstable cardiovascular status due to blood loss, etc.

Before taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have a fever, liver and kidney diseases, an abnormal heart rate, increased thyroid hormones, an enlarged prostate, a digestive problem, or heartburn caused by a ‘hiatus hernia’ (a condition in which part of your stomach pushes through the diaphragm).

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE should be used with caution by pregnant women if recommended by your doctor. GASTRAZINE CAPSULE is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women or children below 6 months of age. The most common side effects of taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE involve dizziness, dry mouth, weakness, vision disturbances, nausea, muscle pain, an increased tendency to sleep, a lack of energy, etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms are worsening.
usesDetails:
Uses Of GASTRAZINE CAPSULE

It is used in adults and children to relieve symptoms of inflammatory bowel disease (inflammation of the large intestine) such as:

Stomach pain
Pain in the gut
Hyperacidity
Heartburn
Excessive gas
Bloating
Constipation or loose motion
Burping
mechanismOfAction:
How GASTRAZINE CAPSULE Works

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE contains dicyclomine, oxethazine, and simethicone. Dicyclomine relaxes the muscles in the stomach and intestine. It stops sudden muscle contractions. Thus, it helps to relieve symptoms of stomach pain, gut pain, bloating, gas, and discomfort. Oxethazine is an anaesthetic agent that blocks the passage of pain signals from nerves to the brain, thus it helps to relieve the sensation of pain.

Additionally, oxethazine increases the stomach PH and neutralises the gastric acid, thereby relieving hyperacidity problems. Simethicone is an ant flatulent that manages excess gas production by breaking up the gas bubbles, which makes easier elimination of gases.
usageDetails:
How to use GASTRAZINE CAPSULE

Take GASTRAZINE CAPSULE as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. GASTRAZINE CAPSULE can be taken with or without food Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Do not drive or operate machines if you feel sleepier, dizzier, drowsier, altered, or have blurred vision while taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE. Consult your doctor before taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE.

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE should be taken with caution in patients with liver impairment (nonfunctioning of the liver). Consult your doctor before taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE.

GASTRAZINE CAPSULE is not recommended to use in infants below 6 months of age. Consult your doctor before taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE.

Care should be taken while dose selection, a generally lower dose is preferred. Consult a doctor before taking GASTRAZINE CAPSULE.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

Before administering CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if the child is suspected of glaucoma, and/or have hiatus hernia with reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), thyrotoxicosis (high thyroxine level in blood), high blood pressure, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or heart problems (such as coronary heart disease).

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in children. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in infants (aged below 6 months). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in elderly patients as it is intended to be used only in children.

The most common side effects of administering CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

Introduction About CIZASPA SR CAPSULE

CIZASPA SR CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take CIZASPA SR CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking CIZASPA SR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take CIZASPA SR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking CIZASPA SR CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

introduction:
Introduction About COLIMEX SUSPENSION

COLIMEX SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. COLIMEX SUSPENSION is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

COLIMEX SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

Before administering COLIMEX SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if the child is suspected of glaucoma, and/or have hiatus hernia with reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), thyrotoxicosis (high thyroxine level in blood), high blood pressure, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or heart problems (such as coronary heart disease).

COLIMEX SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in children. COLIMEX SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in infants (aged below 6 months). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. COLIMEX SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in elderly patients as it is intended to be used only in children.

The most common side effects of administering COLIMEX SUSPENSION in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

How COLIMEX SUSPENSION Works

COLIMEX SUSPENSION works by providing relief from excessive gas formation that occurs due to dyspepsia/gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, where Dicyclomine relieves abdominal cramps and pain by relaxing muscles in stomach and gut, and Simethicone facilitates easy gas passage by disintegrating gas bubbles in affected children.

Administer COLIMEX SUSPENSION in child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the exact dose and duration of management for your child depending on child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

name: Mef Spas Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MEF SPAS TABLET

MEF SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEF SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEF SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEF SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEF SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEF SPAS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEF SPAS TABLET

It is used to manage:

Abdominal pain
Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEF SPAS TABLET Works

MEF SPAS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEF SPAS TABLET

Take MEF SPAS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEF SPAS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEF SPAS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.
sideEffects: Peptic ulcers, perforation or gastrointestinal bleeding (in elderly)

Signs of gastric problems such as ulcers in stomach, perforation or stomach bleeding leading to nausea, loss of taste, vomiting, diarrhea, bloated feeling, constipation, indigestion, stomach pain, blood in vomit and in stools, ulcers in mouth, inflammatory bowel disease (Crohn's disease)

Signs of blood related disorders such as hemolytic anemia (reversible), hypoplastic bone marrow, reduced in red blood cell, platelets, white blood cell count (leukopenia) with an increased risk of infection, sepsis and clotting disordering leading to uncontrollable bleeding

Severe allergic reactions such as asthma, bronchospasm or difficulty in breathing, skin disorders including rashes of various types, redness, extreme itching and rarely exfoliative or bullous skin lesions (including epidermal necrolysis and erythema multiforme)
Glucose intolerance in diabetic patients, low sodium levels in circulation

Signs of nervous system disorders such as pain with eye movement and temporary vision loss in one eye, headaches, tingling, altered sensation, dizziness, drowsiness, numbness, mental confusion, excitement (especially in elderly persons), loss of sensation, speech disturbance, sleeplessness, aseptic meningitis (especially in patients with existing auto-immune disorders, such as systemic lupus erythematosus, mixed connective tissue disease), with symptoms such as stiff neck, headache, nausea, vomiting, fever or disorientation, blurred vision, convulsions, insomnia
Eye irritation, reversible loss of color vision, visual disturbances like blurred vision, double vision, dilation, cycloplegia, increased eye pressure

introduction:
Introduction About AVAPAR 50 TABLET

AVAPAR 50 TABLET is a combination of Camylofin and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodics, Analgesics and Antipyretics respectively. It is used in the management of abdominal pain and spasm associated with Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), spasms associated with diarrhea and dysentery, renal colic (pain when the stone gets stuck in the urinary tract causing painful, bloody, or cloudy urination), biliary colic (pain in the abdomen due to obstruction by stones in the bile duct), intestinal colic (cramp-like pain in the small or large intestine) and dysmenorrhea (period or menstrual cramps around the abdomen, hips, lower back).  

Having a fiber-rich diet, keeping yourself hydrated, and quitting smoking and alcohol will help in the management process. Prior to the management, your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests.

Avoid smoking and consumption of alcohol during this management. AVAPAR 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have narrow-angle glaucoma, prostatic hypertrophy, mechanical stenoses, megacolon, GI hemorrhage, tachyarrhythmia, porphyria, and urinary retention.

Before taking AVAPAR 50 TABLET inform your doctor if you have paralytic ileus, ulcerative colitis, pyloric stenosis, thyrotoxicosis, obstructive lung disease, liver problems, kidney problems, heart problems, fever, and hypertension.

AVAPAR 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. AVAPAR 50 TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age.

It should be used with caution above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking AVAPAR 50 TABLET are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dry mouth, giddiness, dilated pupil, skin rash, and fast heartbeat. Consult your doctor for advice if above side effects do not improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How AVAPAR 50 TABLET Works

AVAPAR 50 TABLET works by relieving muscle cramps and pain in which Camylofin is an antispasmodic that relaxes the muscles in the stomach and intestine stopping sudden muscle contractions (spasms), thereby relieving cramps and pain. Paracetamol is an analgesic (pain reliever) and an antipyretic (fever reducer) that works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that causes fever and pain.

Take AVAPAR 50 TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About DROTIKIND 80MG TABLET

DROTIKIND 80MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROTIKIND 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIKIND 80MG TABLET Works

DROTIKIND 80MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFZEST SPAS 10 TABLET Works

MEFZEST SPAS 10 TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFZEST SPAS 10 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFZEST SPAS 10 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

introduction:
Introduction About HIFENAC SPAS TABLET

HIFENAC SPAS TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use HIFENAC SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking HIFENAC SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

HIFENAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. HIFENAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking HIFENAC SPAS TABLET. The most common side effects of taking HIFENAC SPAS TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

mechanismOfAction:
How HIFENAC SPAS TABLET Works

HIFENAC SPAS TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use HIFENAC SPAS TABLET

Always take HIFENAC SPAS TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of HIFENAC SPAS TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking HIFENAC SPAS TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET

MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET Works

MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET

Take MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFTAL SPAS DS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

introduction:
Introduction About MEB SR CAPSULE

MEB SR CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MEB SR CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MEB SR CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MEB SR CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MEB SR CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEB SR CAPSULE

It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps or spasms in adult patients with:

Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)
Chronic irritable colon
Spastic constipation
Mucous colitis
Spastic colitis
mechanismOfAction:
How MEB SR CAPSULE Works

MEB SR CAPSULE is an antispasmodic medication. It relaxes the smooth muscles of the stomach and the intestines which therefore relieves painful muscle cramps caused due to irritable bowel syndrome and other stomach conditions.

Take MEB SR CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by the physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and health condition.

name: Spas Tablet 15's
introduction:
Introduction About SPAS TABLET

SPAS TABLET is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). It is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol, which belong to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesics, and Antipyretics, respectively. It works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes and inhibiting prostaglandin synthesis, thus relieving pain.

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking SPAS TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. SPAS TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute hemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. SPAS TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking SPAS TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

faqs.question: Q: What is SPAS TABLET used for?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS). Consult your doctor before taking SPAS TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: What are the side effects of taking SPAS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: The most common side effects of taking SPAS TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

faqs.question: Q: Is SPAS TABLET safe during pregnancy?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. Contact your doctor before taking SPAS TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Is SPAS TABLET safe during breast-feeding?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET is not recommended for breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking SPAS TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: Can we use SPAS TABLET in children?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking SPAS TABLET.

faqs.question: Q: How does SPAS TABLET work?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET is an antispasmodic that works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is an analgesic and an antipyretic as well. It works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes and managing prostaglandin synthesis, thus relieving pain.

faqs.question: Q: Is SPAS TABLET good for stomach pain?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET relieves stomach and intestinal cramps, muscle spasms, abdominal pain, constipation, and other GI discomforts by relaxing the muscles and managing normal gut movements.

faqs.question: Q: Is SPAS TABLET used for periods?
faqs.answer: A: SPAS TABLET helps to relieve the symptoms of menstrual (period-related) pain and cramping.

faqs.question: Q: Who should not take SPAS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Do not take SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to dicyclomine or paracetamol or if you have an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute hemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis. Consult your doctor before taking it.

faqs.question: Q: What precautions must be taken while using SPAS TABLET?
faqs.answer: A: Before taking SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have severe liver, kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, heat prostration (such as fever and heat stroke because of decreased sweating), psychosis and delirium, incomplete intestinal obstruction, salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis, prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, and alcoholism.

Introduction About PAMASPAS TABLET

PamaSpas Plus Tablet is a prescription medicine designed for women experiencing discomfort during their menstrual cycle. Formulated with a unique blend of active ingredients, it effectively targets both physical and emotional symptoms such as cramps, bloating, mood swings, and fatigue, associated with dysmenorrhea (painful periods) and premenstrual syndrome (PMS).

It works by relaxing smooth muscles in the uterus and gastrointestinal tract, minimizing painful contractions and spasms. Moreover, it helps reduce water retention, relieving bloating, breast tenderness, and the heavy sensation many experiences during their cycle.

Take Pamaspas plus tablet with food to avoid stomach irritation. It is usually 1-3 times depending on the intensity of menstrual symptoms and only during 3-7 days of menstruation. Do not take this medicine for more than 7 days straight without consulting your doctor. Drink plenty of water and fluid while taking this medicine to avoid dehydration.

Pamaspas plus tablet should not be used in pregnant women due to risk of delay in onset of labour. It passes in breast milk, hence should be avoided in breastfeeding women.

Before taking Pamaspas tablet, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, kidney problems, history of asthma, have active ulcers or bleeding in the gut, inflammatory bowel disease or block or obstruction in the intestines as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking Pamaspas plus tablet include dry mouth, dizziness, nausea, light-headedness, gastrointestinal discomfort such as stomach pain, heartburn, headache, drowsiness or skin rash. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PAMASPAS TABLET Works

Pamaspas Plus Tablet contains three active ingredients namely, dicyclomine, pamabrom, and mefenamic acid, each contributing to its effectiveness.

Dicyclomine: This is an antispasmodic agent that relaxes the smooth muscles in the stomach and intestines, helping to reduce painful cramps and spasms.
Pamabrom: A mild diuretic, pamabrom helps reduce water retention and bloating often associated with premenstrual syndrome (PMS) and other conditions.
Mefenamic Acid: This is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that alleviates pain and inflammation by blocking the production of prostaglandins, substances in the body responsible for causing pain and swelling.

The combination of these ingredients provides relief from pain, reduce inflammation, alleviate bloating, and relax muscles, making Pamaspas Plus Tablet highly effective for managing abdominal discomfort and related symptoms.

Diet Tips To Manage Menstrual Cramps:
Eat Anti-inflammatory Foods: Include fruits, vegetables, whole grains, nuts, seeds, and fatty fish (like salmon) to reduce inflammation and ease cramps.
Increase Magnesium Intake: Foods like spinach, bananas, almonds, and dark chocolate can help relax muscles and alleviate cramps.
Stay Hydrated: Drink plenty of water or herbal teas (like chamomile or ginger) to reduce bloating and relax the uterine muscles.
Limit Caffeine and Salt: Avoid excess coffee, tea, or salty snacks, as they can worsen bloating and irritability.

Light Cardio: Activities like walking, jogging, or cycling can increase blood flow and reduce cramps.
Yoga: Gentle yoga poses like Child’s Pose, Cat-Cow Stretch, or Reclining Bound Angle Pose can relieve abdominal pain and relax your body.
Stretching: Stretch your back, hips, and thighs to ease muscle tension and reduce discomfort.
Core-Strengthening Exercises: Pilates and core-focused exercises can help reduce cramping by improving circulation to the abdomen.

introduction:
Introduction About COLIMEX DROPS

COLIMEX DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. COLIMEX DROPS is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

COLIMEX DROPS is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

Before administering COLIMEX DROPS, inform your doctor if the child is suspected of glaucoma, and/or have hiatus hernia with reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), thyrotoxicosis (high thyroxine level in blood), high blood pressure, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or heart problems (such as coronary heart disease).

COLIMEX DROPS is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in children. COLIMEX DROPS is not recommended for use in infants (aged below 6 months). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. COLIMEX DROPS is not recommended for use in elderly patients as it is intended to be used only in children.

The most common side effects of administering COLIMEX DROPS in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

introduction:
Introduction About MOREASE I SACHET

MOREASE I SACHET is a combination of Ispaghula Husk and Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Natural plant materials and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve the symptoms of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), at the same time it helps to restore and maintain bowel regularity.  

Irritable bowel syndrome is a disease condition that affects the large intestine. The most common symptoms are abdominal cramping, change in bowel habits, bloating, constipation, and diarrhoea.  

Before taking MOREASE I SACHET, inform your doctor if you have blockage of the bowel, decreased activity of the bowel, difficulty in swallowing, throat problems, severe constipation, bleeding from the bowel or sudden change in bowel habits.

MOREASE I SACHET should be used with caution in patients having reduced kidney function, phenylketonuria, nausea, vomiting, loss of appetite or weight, fever, vaginal bleeding or discharge, difficulty or pain during urination or acute porphyria.   

MOREASE I SACHET should be used with caution in pregnant women and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. This medicine is not recommended for use in children (below 12 year of age) and should be used with caution in elderly patients.  

During management with this medicine if you experience allergic skin reaction such as rash or itching and swollen face or breathing problems, consult your doctor immediately.

mechanismOfAction:
How MOREASE I SACHET Works

MOREASE I SACHET relives irritable bowel syndrome, in which ispaghula husk works by increasing bulk contents of the gut passing through the digestive system and helps the body to work normally. Mebeverine is an antispasmodic drug which helps in relieving the cramps and spasm occurring in the gut causing pain.
usageDetails:
How to use MOREASE I SACHET

Take MOREASE I SACHET as advised by your physician. Empty the contents of the sachet into a glass of normal water (150 ml), then stir the content and drink immediately. Do not take this medicine without water. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MOREASE I SACHET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Others

Have severe constipation or have passed blood from the bowel

Have phenylketonuria (inherited condition)
Have stomach pain and nausea or vomiting
Have loss of appetite or weight
Are aged 40 years or above
Are feeling weak, tired or looking pale
Have fever
Are taking potassium restricted diet
Have vaginal bleeding or discharge
Have difficulty or pain during urination
Have acute porphyria (metabolic disorder affecting the production of heme)
Have recently travelled abroad

Use in paediatrics:

MOREASE I SACHET is not recommended for use in children (aged below 12 years). Consult your child’s doctor for advice before administering this medicine to your child.

Use in geriatrics:

MOREASE I SACHET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOMEFF TABLET

CYCLOMEFF TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

CYCLOMEFF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). CYCLOMEFF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

CYCLOMEFF TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. CYCLOMEFF TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking CYCLOMEFF TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Uses Of CYCLOMEFF TABLET

It is used to manage:

Abdominal pain

mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOMEFF TABLET Works

CYCLOMEFF TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOMEFF TABLET

Take CYCLOMEFF TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of CYCLOMEFF TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of CYCLOMEFF TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

CYCLOMEFF TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy as it can cause heart defects in the fetus (premature closure of heart duct), delay in onset of labour and increased bleeding tendency in mother. Consult your doctor before taking CYCLOMEFF TABLET.

CYCLOMEFF TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women due to increased risk of serious adverse reactions in nursing infants. CYCLOMEFF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing asthma and aspirin-sensitive asthma. Consult your doctor before taking CYCLOMEFF TABLET.

CYCLOMEFF TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as heart failure, hypertension) as well as increased heart rate conditions such as thyrotoxicosis, congestive heart failure and in cardiac surgery. interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking CYCLOMEFF TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of CYCLOMEFF TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

name: Anafortan Injection 2ml
introduction:
Introduction About ANAFORTAN INJECTION

ANAFORTAN INJECTION contains Camylofin which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used for the management of spasms associated with Irritable bowel syndrome (a disorder affecting the stomach and intestine), spasms associated with diarrhoea and dysentery (infection of the intestine that causes diarrhea containing blood and mucus), renal colic (pain due to kidney stones), biliary colic (pain due to gall stones) and dysmenorrhoea (painful menstrual periods).

ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having tachyarrythmia (fast heartbeat), narrow-angle glaucoma, gastrointestinal bleeding, urinary retention. Contact your doctor before receiving it.

ANAFORTAN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with obstructive lung disease, cardiac insufficiency, thyrotoxicosis, paralytic ileus, ulcerative colitis. Contact your doctor before receiving it.

ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. ANAFORTAN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before receiving it.

The most common side effects of receiving ANAFORTAN INJECTION are nausea, vomiting, drowsiness, dry mouth, giddiness, skin rash, dilated pupils and fast heartbeats. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANAFORTAN INJECTION

To manage spasms associated with:

Irritable bowel syndrome
Diarrhoea and dysentery
Renal colic, biliary colic
Dysmenorrhoea
mechanismOfAction:
How ANAFORTAN INJECTION Works

ANAFORTAN INJECTION effectively reduces abdominal pain or menstrual cramps where Camylofin work by relaxing smooth muscles of intestine, ureter and relaxes them and thereby provides relief from the associated colicky pain.
usageDetails:
How to use ANAFORTAN INJECTION

ANAFORTAN INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the muscle as an intramuscular injection. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in pregnant women. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as there is no data on safety and efficacy. Consult your doctor before receiving it.
Do not receive ANAFORTAN INJECTION if you are allergic to Camylofin or any other ingredients of this medicine.
ANAFORTAN INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with obstructive lung disease. Contact your doctor before receiving it.

ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients having tachyarrythmia (fast heartbeat). It should be received with caution in patients with cardiac insufficiency and during cardiac surgery. Consult your doctor before receiving ANAFORTAN INJECTION.

Others

ANAFORTAN INJECTION is not recommended for use if you:

Have narrow-angle glaucoma (increased eye pressure)
Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)
Have mechanical stenoses (partial or complete blockage in intestine)
Have mega colon (abnormal dilation of colon)
Have gastrointestinal bleeding
Have porphyria (red blood cell disorder)
Have urinary retention

Before receiving ANAFORTAN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you:

Have thyrotoxicosis (overactive thyroid disease)
Have fever
Have paralytic ileus (blockage of intestine due to paralysis of intestinal muscles)
Have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon and rectum)
Have pyloric stenosis (gastric outlet obstruction)

Use in Pediatrics:

name: PAMASPAS PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About PAMASPAS PLUS TABLET

PamaSpas Plus Tablet is a prescription medicine designed for women experiencing discomfort during their menstrual cycle. Formulated with a unique blend of active ingredients, it effectively targets both physical and emotional symptoms such as cramps, bloating, mood swings, and fatigue, associated with dysmenorrhea (painful periods) and premenstrual syndrome (PMS).

It works by relaxing smooth muscles in the uterus and gastrointestinal tract, minimizing painful contractions and spasms. Moreover, it helps reduce water retention, relieving bloating, breast tenderness, and the heavy sensation many experiences during their cycle.

Take Pamaspas plus tablet with food to avoid stomach irritation. It is usually 1-3 times depending on the intensity of menstrual symptoms and only during 3-7 days of menstruation. Do not take this medicine for more than 7 days straight without consulting your doctor. Drink plenty of water and fluid while taking this medicine to avoid dehydration.

Pamaspas plus tablet should not be used in pregnant women due to risk of delay in onset of labour. It passes in breast milk, hence should be avoided in breastfeeding women.

Before taking Pamaspas tablet, inform your doctor if you have severe liver problems, kidney problems, history of asthma, have active ulcers or bleeding in the gut, inflammatory bowel disease or block or obstruction in the intestines as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking Pamaspas plus tablet include dry mouth, dizziness, nausea, light-headedness, gastrointestinal discomfort such as stomach pain, heartburn, headache, drowsiness or skin rash. Inform your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How PAMASPAS PLUS TABLET Works

Pamaspas Plus Tablet contains three active ingredients namely, dicyclomine, pamabrom, and mefenamic acid, each contributing to its effectiveness.

Dicyclomine: This is an antispasmodic agent that relaxes the smooth muscles in the stomach and intestines, helping to reduce painful cramps and spasms.
Pamabrom: A mild diuretic, pamabrom helps reduce water retention and bloating often associated with premenstrual syndrome (PMS) and other conditions.
Mefenamic Acid: This is a non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug (NSAID) that alleviates pain and inflammation by blocking the production of prostaglandins, substances in the body responsible for causing pain and swelling.

The combination of these ingredients provides relief from pain, reduce inflammation, alleviate bloating, and relax muscles, making Pamaspas Plus Tablet highly effective for managing abdominal discomfort and related symptoms.

warningsRaw:
Warning & Precautions
Pregnancy
CONTRAINDICATED
Pamaspas Plus Tablet is intended to manage menstrual cramps and other symptoms associated with menstruation. Therefore, this medicine is not used in pregnant women.
There are no well controlled studies regarding the use of combination dicyclomine + mefenamic acid + pamabrom during pregnancy. However, individual studies with mefenamic acid, indicate that such pain killers may delay onset of labour in pregnant women and may cause harm to the fetus.
Hence, Pamaspas plus tablet is not recommended for use in pregnant unless considered necessary by the physician.

CONTRAINDICATED

Active ingredients like dicyclomine and mefenamic acid present in the medicine have been shown to excrete in breast milk of lactating women. Therefore, Pamaspas plus tablet is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women.

introduction:
Introduction About ALCINAC SPAS TABLET

ALCINAC SPAS TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use ALCINAC SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking ALCINAC SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

ALCINAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. ALCINAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking ALCINAC SPAS TABLET. The most common side effects of taking ALCINAC SPAS TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.

introduction:
Introduction About DOVERIN M TABLET

DOVERIN M TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation, and migraine headache.

DOVERIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

DOVERIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DOVERIN M TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DOVERIN M TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. DOVERIN M TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DOVERIN M TABLET Works

DOVERIN M TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).
usageDetails:
How to use DOVERIN M TABLET

Take DOVERIN M TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow DOVERIN M TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse DOVERIN M TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DOVERIN M TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: BIOSPAS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About BIOSPAS TABLET

BIOSPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking BIOSPAS TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. BIOSPAS TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

BIOSPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

BIOSPAS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. BIOSPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. BIOSPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. BIOSPAS TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking BIOSPAS TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

Manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)

BIOSPAS TABLET is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). introduction:
Introduction About DVN 80MG TABLET

DVN 80MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DVN 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DVN 80MG TABLET Works

DVN 80MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

introduction:
Introduction About SPASMODART TABLET

SPASMODART TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, Paracetamol and Diclofenac which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesics & Antipyretic agents and Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs respectively. It is used to relieve pain and spasm in conditions like primary dysmenorrhoea, spasmodic dysmenorrhoea, surgical pain & spasm, renal colic, biliary colic, uterine colic (pain due to block in urinary tract by stone) and backache.

Dysmenorrhoea is a cramping pain in the lower abdomen which occurs before or after menstruation. Spasmodic dysmenorrhoea is a painful spasm during menstruation.

SPASMODART TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma, liver, kidney and heart. Consult your doctor for advice.

SPASMODART TABLET is not recommended for use in woman who are pregnant. It should be used with caution in breastfeeding woman. Consult your doctor for advice.

SPASMODART TABLET is not recommended for use in children below 6 years of age and it should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor for advice.

The most common side effects of taking SPASMODART TABLET are stomach pain, indigestion, heart burn and vomiting. Consult your doctor if the symptoms does not improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMODART TABLET Works

SPASMODART TABLET act as a painkiller and muscle relaxant where Diclofenac and Paracetamol works by reducing the effects of prostaglandin (substance produced during injury and inflammation causing pain) thereby blocking the pain signals between the brain and nerve endings and Dicyclomine blocks the effects of  bradykinin and histamine (chemical substances responsible for muscle contraction) thereby reduces muscle contraction and provide relief from spasms.

Take SPASMODART TABLET as advised by your doctor. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

name: MEFZEST SPAS 20 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET

MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET

It is used to manage:

Abdominal pain
Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET Works

MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET

Take MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFZEST SPAS 20 TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

name: SPADROT Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About SPADROT TABLET

SPADROT TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking SPADROT TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.
