mechanismOfAction:
How SPADROT TABLET Works

SPADROT TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.
usageInstructions: Take SPADROT TABLET should be taken as prescribed by your doctor.
Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.
It can be taken with or without food.
The dosage and frequency depend on your medical condition and how your body responds to the treatment.
It is important not to exceed the recommended dose, and you should take it at the same time every day if it's prescribed regularly

There are no adequate data on the use of Drotaverine in lactation women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Studies have shown that drotaverine can harm your kidneys. Therefore, this medicine is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing kidney conditions.
This medicine should be used with caution in patients having liver problems.
Do not take SPADROT TABLET if you are allergic to drotaverine and mefenamic acid
This medicine should not be used in patients suffering from allergic rhinitis, urticaria, or asthma.
This medicine should be used with caution in patients having heart problems.
Drotaverine tablets can be used in children and adolescents if prescribed by the physician. It is not suitable for use in infants and neonates aged below 1 year.
SPADROT TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially with pre-existing illnesses.

Others

SPADROT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients suffering from:

Stomach ulcers or inflammation
Porphyria

introduction:
Introduction About TINNICAR CAPSULE

TINNICAR CAPSULE is used in the management of abdominal pain and tinnitus. It contains Caroverine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antispasmodic agents. TINNICAR CAPSULE works by blocking specific calcium channels and modifying neurotransmitter release in the nervous system. This helps in reducing abnormal nerve activity that leads to muscle spasms and protects the inner ear's nerve cells.

Before taking TINNICAR CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart disease. There are limited studies available for pregnant and breastfeeding women. TINNICAR CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, though taking it with food may reduce gastrointestinal side effects.

The most common side effects of TINNICAR CAPSULE are drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, upset stomach or rash, itching, or swelling (allergic reactions). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms bothers you.

Introduction About MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION

MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

Before administering MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if the child is suspected of glaucoma, and/or have hiatus hernia with reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), thyrotoxicosis (high thyroxine level in blood), high blood pressure, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or heart problems (such as coronary heart disease).

MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in children. MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in infants (aged below 6 months). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in elderly patients as it is intended to be used only in children.

The most common side effects of administering MEFTAL SPAS SUSPENSION in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

introduction:
Introduction About DROTIKIND INJECTION

DROTIKIND INJECTION is an antispasmodic agent used for renal colic, biliary colic, smooth muscle spasm of bladder and urinary tract, menstrual cramps, abdominal cramps and other pain related to smooth muscles. It can also be used for cervical dilation during labour in some cases.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Before taking DROTIKIND INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are pain at injection site, dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIKIND INJECTION Works

DROTIKIND INJECTION contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

introduction:
Introduction About SPASTONE DROPS

SPASTONE DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Dimethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodic agents and Anti-foaming agents respectively. It is used for the management of functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome, gastric distension, functional digestive disorders and stomach pain in children.

Before giving SPASTONE DROPS inform your doctor if your child have diarrhea, ulcerative colitis, thyroid problems, hypertension, liver problems, kidney problems or heart problems, history of allergy, intolerance to any food products and abdominal obstruction.

Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. SPASTONE DROPS may cause your child to sweat less, increasing his or her risk of heatstroke. Avoid overheating by avoiding strenuous work or exercise in hot weather and using hot baths.

Give the prescribed dose to your child orally before a meal or as directed by the doctor. Do not abruptly stop the medicine by yourself as it may bring back the symptoms or worsen your child’s condition.

The most common side effects of this medicine are dryness in the mouth, dizziness, weakness, sleepiness, nervousness, blurred vision and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

If these side effects occur, they will subside once your child’s body adapts to the medicine. In case these side effects do not improve or become bothersome for your child, contact your doctor immediately.

It stops sudden contractions of the muscle (spasms), thereby relieving abdominal cramps and pain. Dimethicone works by disintegrating the gas bubbles and allowing easy passage of gas. Hence it helps to reduce the abdominal pain caused due to cramps, spasms and gas formation.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION

MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION contains Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs. It is used to relieve the symptoms of inflammation such as redness and swelling. It can be used to manage pain and discomfort caused due to arthritis (inflammation of joints) muscular diseases or rheumatoid disorders (inflammatory disorders affecting the muscles and joints). It can also be used in the management of headache, muscle pain, tooth ache, post operative pain, childbirth pain, fever in children and painful or heavy periods.

Your doctor may monitor your kidney or liver function before and during the management to make sure they are functioning properly. Your doctor may also suggest you perform blood tests during the management to check your health condition.

MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients have or ever had stomach or intestinal conditions such as stomach ulcer, bleeding in the stomach, severe gastritis (inflammation of lining of the stomach) and inflammatory diseases of the intestine such as ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease.

Avoid consumption of alcohol and smoking while taking MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION as it may irritate your stomach and worsen the side effects.

MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION is not recommended in patients having severe kidney, liver and heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant women particularly in the last 3 months of pregnancy as this may delay the onset of labour and prolong its duration. It is not recommended among breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Your doctor will give the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. Consult your doctor for advice before taking MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION.

However, MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged over 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of MEFNIWEL SUSPENSION are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen or persists for a longer time.

Introduction About MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE

MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE contains Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used in adults to manage painful muscle spasms of the stomach and the intestines. It is used for the symptomatic management of irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) and other similar stomach conditions (such as chronic irritable colon, spastic constipation, mucous colitis and spastic colitis) that causes painful spasms or cramps of the gut muscles.

Take MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE 20 minutes before meals or as directed by your physician. Along with the management, follow the diet changes that suits your body and eat foods rich in fibre (such as cereals pulses, fruits etc.) to lessen the symptoms.

Before taking MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you experience new any symptoms of IBS or worsening of existing symptoms as a precaution.

Do not take MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE if you are pregnant or breastfeeding without consulting your doctor. The most common side-effects of taking MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE are skin rash, redness or irritation. Contact your doctor if it troubles you.

Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS)

How MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE Works

MATIZ SR 200MG CAPSULE is an antispasmodic medication. It relaxes the smooth muscles of the stomach and the intestines which therefore relieves painful muscle cramps caused due to irritable bowel syndrome and other stomach conditions.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFZOX SPAS TABLET

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFZOX SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.
uses: Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
usesDetails:
Uses Of MEFZOX SPAS TABLET

It is used to manage:

Abdominal pain
Dysmenorrhea (severe and frequent menstrual cramps and pain during menses)
mechanismOfAction:
How MEFZOX SPAS TABLET Works

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFZOX SPAS TABLET

Take MEFZOX SPAS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFZOX SPAS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFZOX SPAS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: MEFZOX SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy only if considered clearly necessary. MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is strictly not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy as it can cause heart defects in the fetus (premature closure of heart duct), delay in onset of labour and increased bleeding tendency in mother. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women due to increased risk of serious adverse reactions in nursing infants. If MEFZOX SPAS TABLET therapy is essential to mother, breast-feeding must be discontinued during management period. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, drowsiness, fatigue, visual disturbances or blurred vision after taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET because it might increase gastrointestinal bleeding, ulceration and perforation.

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy or in patients with significantly impaired renal function. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.
MEFZOX SPAS TABLET should be taken with caution in patients with impaired liver function. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.
Do not take MEFZOX SPAS TABLET if you are allergic to Dicyclomine or Mefenamic acid or any other ingredients of this medicine.
MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing asthma and aspirin-sensitive asthma. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.

MEFZOX SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (such as heart failure, hypertension) as well as increased heart rate conditions such as thyrotoxicosis, congestive heart failure and in cardiac surgery. MEFZOX SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in management of peri-operative pain in the setting of coronary artery bypass graft (CABG) surgery. Consult your doctor before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFZOX SPAS TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFZOX SPAS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

name: EPIMAC PLUS Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About EPIMAC PLUS TABLET

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET is a combination of Eperisone and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Muscle relaxants and Analgesics respectively. It is used to manage pain due to muscle spasm.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking this medicine as it may severely damage the liver.  EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver disease or disorder and kidney disease.

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women unless advised by the doctor and it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. EPIMAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety data and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). 

The most common side effects of taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET are nausea, vomiting, stomach discomfort, abdominal pain, general discomfort and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsen over the time.
uses: Manage pain due to muscle spasm
usesDetails:
Uses Of EPIMAC PLUS TABLET
Manage pain due to muscle spasm
mechanismOfAction:
How EPIMAC PLUS TABLET Works

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET helps to manage pain due to muscle spasm, where eperisone works by acting on the centres in the brain and spinal cord. It also dilates vascular smooth muscles improving blood flow and relieves muscle spasm. Paracetamol works by increasing the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes.
usageDetails:
How to use EPIMAC PLUS TABLET

Take EPIMAC PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow EPIMAC PLUS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET without informing your doctor.

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you feel weakness, sleepiness, light-headedness after taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET as it may severely damage the liver.
EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney disease. Consult your doctor before taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET.
EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver disorder or disease (including Gilbert’s syndrome or hepatitis). Consult your doctor before taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET.
Do not take EPIMAC PLUS TABLET if you are allergic to Eperisone, Paracetamol or other ingredients of this medicine.
EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with asthma. Consult your doctor before taking EPIMAC PLUS TABLET.

Others

Are dehydrated or have impaired nutritional state (caused by alcohol abuse or wrong nutrition)
Haemolytic anaemia (abnormal breakdown of red blood cells)
Deficiency of glucose- 6-phosphatedehydrogenase enzyme
Serious infection such as blood poisoning

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children due to lack of safety data. Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

EPIMAC PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About DROVOTAS 80MG TABLET

DROVOTAS 80MG TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROVOTAS 80MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROVOTAS 80MG TABLET Works

DROVOTAS 80MG TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

introduction:
Introduction About DROZIVER PLUS TABLET

DROZIVER PLUS TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Analgesics & Antipyretics respectively. It is used to manage and relieve pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, menstrual cramps, cervical spasm during labour, headache, chest pain, gallstones pain and pain in renal colic. This medicine also manages spasm or twitches of the smooth muscles in the stomach and heart.

DROZIVER PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe liver or kidney disease and heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking. Before taking DROZIVER PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have lung, liver or kidney disease or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking. DROZIVER PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant and breastfeeding women. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROZIVER PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children under 10 years of age. Contact your doctor before taking. DROZIVER PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking. The most common side effects of this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, nausea and vomiting, fluctuating pulse rate, headache and skin reactions. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DROZIVER PLUS TABLET

It is used to manage and relieve pain due to:

Irritable bowel syndrome
Menstrual periods
Cervical spasm during labour
Headache
Chest pain
Gallstones and renal colic

It also manages spasm or twitches of the smooth muscles in the stomach and heart.
mechanismOfAction:
How DROZIVER PLUS TABLET Works

DROZIVER PLUS TABLET helps to manage pain, where Drotaverine works by inhibiting phosphodiesterase 4 (an enzyme responsible for the degradation of cyclic adenosine monophosphate CAMP), inhibition of PDE4 leads to elevated levels of CAMP and reduced calcium uptake by the cells, leading to smooth muscle relaxation. Paracetamol relieves pain by reducing the production of prostaglandins in the brain and spinal cord. Prostaglandins are produced by the body in response to injury and certain diseases.

Take DROZIVER PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow this medicine as whole with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFZOX D TABLET

MEFZOX D TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation and migraine headache.

MEFZOX D TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFZOX D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. MEFZOX D TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

MEFZOX D TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. MEFZOX D TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFZOX D TABLET Works

MEFZOX D TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MEFZOX D TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About DORIN DS TABLET

DORIN DS TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DORIN DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

How DORIN DS TABLET Works

DORIN DS TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFTAL SPAS DROPS

MEFTAL SPAS DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. MEFTAL SPAS DROPS is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

MEFTAL SPAS DROPS is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

The most common side effects of administering MEFTAL SPAS DROPS in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

introduction:
Introduction About DROTIGO MF TABLET

DROTIGO MF TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation and migraine headache.

DROTIGO MF TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROTIGO MF TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DROTIGO MF TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROTIGO MF TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. DROTIGO MF TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIGO MF TABLET Works

DROTIGO MF TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DROTIGO MF TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: Hyocimax S Injection 1ml
introduction:
Introduction About HYOCIMAX S INJECTION

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION contains Hyoscyamine, which belongs to the group of medicines called the Anticholinergic/Antispasmodic agents. It is used as an adjunctive therapy to manage peptic ulcers. It is also used to control gastric secretions, spasms in the internal organs, increased contractions & abdominal cramps associated with conditions such as spastic colitis (abnormal gut contractions), spastic bladder (sudden contractions of the bladder), cystitis (inflammation of the urinary bladder), and pylorospasm (abnormal contraction of the lower part of the stomach).

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is also used as adjunctive therapy to manage irritable bowel syndrome (irritable colon, spastic colon, and mucous colitis), functional gastrointestinal disorders, neurogenic bladder, and neurogenic bowel disturbances (splenic flexure syndrome and neurogenic colon) in affected individuals.

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is also used to reduce gut motility to facilitate diagnostic procedures (such as endoscopy or hypotonic duodenography), which is also used to reduce pain and hypersecretion in pancreatitis. The medicine is also used to manage partial heart block associated with vagal activity, which is also used to manage poisoning by anticholinesterase agents (agents that increase parasympathetic nerve stimulation) in affected individuals.

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is also used as a pre-operative antimuscarinic agent to reduce salivary, airway, and gastric secretions and also to block cardiac vagal inhibitory reflexes (a sudden drop in blood pressure and heart rate) during the induction of anaesthesia and intubation, which also protects against peripheral muscarinic effects (such as increased heart rate and excessive secretions) produced by halogenated hydrocarbons and cholinergic agents (such as physostigmine, neostigmine, and pyridostigmine).

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is also used to improve the radiologic visibility of the kidneys and to provide symptomatic relief for biliary colic (pain in the liver or gall bladder) and renal colic (pain in the kidney) in affected individuals.

A peptic ulcer is a condition that occurs when stomach acid damages the lining of the digestive tract. It is generally characterised by symptoms such as a burning sensation in the stomach, bloating, and/or heartburn. Irritable bowel syndrome is a common disorder that affects the large intestine and is characterised by symptoms such as abdominal cramping, diarrhoea, constipation, and bloating in affected individuals.

Functional intestinal disorders are common disorders that are generally characterised by persistent and recurring gastrointestinal symptoms such as abdominal pain, an inability to swallow, and indigestion. A neurogenic bladder is a condition in which a person loses control over urination due to brain, spinal cord, or nerve problems.

Neurogenic bowel disturbances (splenic flexure syndrome and neurogenic colon) are conditions in which a person loses control over normal bowel functioning due to the brain, spinal, or nerve problems, which are generally characterised by symptoms such as constipation and/or diarrhoea.

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with glaucoma (increased pressure in the eye), obstructive uropathy (hindered urine flow), myasthenia gravis (weak muscles), unstable cardiovascular status, and/or myocardial ischemia. Before receiving HYOCIMAX S INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have a hiatal hernia associated with reflux oesophagitis (inflammation of the oesophagus followed by acid reflux), coronary heart disease and congestive heart failure, reduced liver function, or kidney disease (such as a reduced renal function).

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION should be used with caution in pregnant women only if it is necessary, which is also the case in breastfeeding women. HYOCIMAX S INJECTION should also be used with caution in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

The most common side effects associated with the use of HYOCIMAX S INJECTION are dryness of the mouth and eyes, decreased sweating, headache, visual blurring, constipation, urinary retention, and impotence. Consult your doctor if any of your symptoms worsen.

Have toxic megacolon (a severe complication of ulcerative colitis)

Have signs of hyperthyroidism (increased thyroid levels in the blood) such as unintentional weight loss, rapid heart rate
Have high blood pressure

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with liver disease such as decreased hepatic function. Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

Allergy

Heart Disease

HYOCIMAX S INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with unstable cardiovascular status and myocardial ischemia (reduced blood flow to the heart). It should be used with caution in patients with coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, and/or cardiac arrhythmias (irregular heartbeat). Consult your doctor before receiving the medicine.

A. Drug-Drug Interactions:

Before receiving HYOCIMAX S INJECTION, inform your doctor, if you are taking any of the following medicine:

Cyclopropane (a medicine used to anaesthetize the body)

introduction:
Introduction About DROVOTAS M TABLET

DROVOTAS M TABLET is a combination of Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anti-spasmodic agents and Non-Steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs). It is used to manage pain in the stomach, intestine, urinary tract and pain due to irritable bowel syndrome, pain due to gall stones or kidney stones or liver and kidney disease, pain after surgery or child birth, painful periods (dysmenorrhea), heavy bleeding during periods (menorrhagia). It is also used for fever, muscle pain, inflammation and migraine headache.

DROVOTAS M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney, liver or heart diseases and asthma. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROVOTAS M TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnancy. Contact your doctor before taking. DROVOTAS M TABLET is not recommended for use in breast feeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking.

DROVOTAS M TABLET should be used with caution in children. Contact your doctor before taking. DROVOTAS M TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65 years or above. Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, stomach pain, constipation, dry mouth, lack of appetite, feeling thirsty and heartburn, dizziness and sleepiness. Contact your doctor if any of the above symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROVOTAS M TABLET Works

DROVOTAS M TABLET is a combination of two medicines, Drotaverine and Mefenamic acid, which relieves abdominal pain and cramps. Drotaverine relieves contractions (spasms) associated with smooth muscles in the abdomen. Mefenamic acid works by blocking the release of certain chemical messengers that cause abdominal pain and inflammation (swelling).

How to use DROVOTAS M TABLET

Take DROVOTAS M TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow DROVOTAS M TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse DROVOTAS M TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take DROVOTAS M TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

introduction:
Introduction About BARALGAN NU TABLET

BARALGAN NU TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking BARALGAN NU TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. BARALGAN NU TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

BARALGAN NU TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

BARALGAN NU TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. BARALGAN NU TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. BARALGAN NU TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. BARALGAN NU TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking BARALGAN NU TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFTOMAXX + TABLET

MEFTOMAXX + TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MEFTOMAXX + TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MEFTOMAXX + TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MEFTOMAXX + TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MEFTOMAXX + TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MEFTOMAXX + TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFTOMAXX + TABLET Works

MEFTOMAXX + TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFTOMAXX + TABLET

Take MEFTOMAXX + TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MEFTOMAXX + TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MEFTOMAXX + TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MEFTOMAXX + TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicine used to correct heart rhythm (Ex. digoxin)
Medicine used to manage HIV infection (Ex. Zidovudine)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure such as ACE Inhibitors (Ex. captopril, enalapril, lisinopril, benazepril) and diltiazem
Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAID) that are used to relieve pain Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, diclofenac, celecoxib
Erythromycin, fluoroquinolones such as ciprofloxacin, levofloxacin and aminoglycosides such as amikacin, tobramycin, gentamicin (used to manage bacterial infections)
Ketoconazole (used to manage fungal infections)
Colchicine (used to manage gout)
Lithium, isocarboxazid, phenelzine, amitriptyline (used to manage depression)
Immunosuppressant drugs (used to suppress immune activity) (Ex. methotrexate, cyclosporin, tacrolimus)
Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)
Corticosteroid drugs such as prednisone, prednisolone, methylprednisolone, dexamethasone (used to manage inflammatory conditions)
Latanoprost, tafluprost (used to manage glaucoma)
Antihistamines (Ex. chlorpheniramine, hydroxyzine, dimenhydrinate) (used to manage allergy)
Antipsychotic agents such as chlorpromazine, fluphenazine (used to manage psychosis)
Alprazolam, diazepam (used to manage anxiety and induce sleep)
Narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine) (used to relieve moderate to severe pain)
Nitroglycerin, isosorbide mononitrate (used to manage chest pain)
Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MEFTOMAXX + TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics and Anti flatulent agents, respectively. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is used to provide relief from infantile colic (persistent crying in infants), gastrointestinal tract spasm, flatulence, and abdominal discomfort that occurs due to excessive gas formation in disorders such as dyspepsia (indigestion) and gastro-oesophageal reflux disease (digestive disorder) in affected children.

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children allergic to Dicyclomine, and/or Simethicone. It is also not recommended for use in children with obstructive uropathy (obstructed urinary flow), intestinal obstruction, severe ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage (blood loss), glaucoma (increased eye pressure), and/or myasthenia gravis (autoimmune neuromuscular disease).

Before administering CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION, inform your doctor if the child is suspected of glaucoma, and/or have hiatus hernia with reflux esophagitis (inflammation of the oesophageal mucosa), thyrotoxicosis (high thyroxine level in blood), high blood pressure, liver problems (such as impaired hepatic function), kidney problems (such as renal impairment), and/or heart problems (such as coronary heart disease).

CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women as it is intended to be used only in children. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in infants (aged below 6 months). Consult your doctor before administering the medicine to the child. CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in elderly patients as it is intended to be used only in children.

The most common side effects of administering CYCLOPAM SUSPENSION in child are dry mouth, nausea, blurred vision, dizziness, sleepiness, and/or weakness. Consult your doctor if any of these symptoms becomes worse in the child.

Introduction About CYCLOBID SUSPENSION

CYCLOBID SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), intestinal colic, stomach cramps, infantile colic, renal and biliary colic, worm colic, non-specific abdominal pain, spasmodic dysmenorrhea as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CYCLOBID SUSPENSION, as it may increase the side effects. CYCLOBID SUSPENSION is not recommended in patients with unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis.

CYCLOBID SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver disease, cirrhosis, kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, and cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (small intestine partially or totally blocked).

CYCLOBID SUSPENSION should be also used with caution in patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), autonomic neuropathy (injury to the nerves that regulate automatic body functions), hypothyroidism, hiatal hernia, suffered from alcoholism, malnutrition, arthritis or must take painkillers often, infection, glucose-6-phosphatedehydrogenase deficiency, haemolytic anaemia (breakdown of red blood cells), bleeding problems.

CYCLOBID SUSPENSION should be used during pregnancy, if considered necessary. CYCLOBID SUSPENSION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women and in infants less than 6 months of age. CYCLOBID SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking CYCLOBID SUSPENSION are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms got worse.

How CYCLOBID SUSPENSION Works

CYCLOBID SUSPENSION is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

Introduction About DROTIN INJECTION

DROTIN INJECTION is an antispasmodic agent used for renal colic, biliary colic, smooth muscle spasm of bladder and urinary tract, menstrual cramps, abdominal cramps and other pain related to smooth muscles. It can also be used for cervical dilation during labour in some cases.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Before taking DROTIN INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are pain at injection site, dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIN INJECTION Works

DROTIN INJECTION contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.
usageInstructions: DROTIN INJECTION should be used only under medical supervision
It will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse into the vein or muscles
The dosage and frequency depend on your medical condition and how your body responds to the treatment.

warnings.details: Animal and human studies have not indicated any harm to the growing fetus. However, caution should be exercised before using this medicine in pregnant women.
There are no adequate data on the use of Drotaverine in lactation women. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking this medicine.
Do not drive or handle heavy machines if your ability is affected by this medicine.
Studies have shown that drotaverine can harm your kidneys. Therefore, this medicine is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing kidney conditions.
This medicine is not suitable for use in patients with severe liver conditions. It should be used with caution in patients mild to moderate liver problems.
Do not take DROTIN INJECTION if you are allergic to drotaverine and mefenamic acid
This medicine should not be used in patients suffering from allergic rhinitis, urticaria, or asthma.
This medicine is not suitable for use in patients with severe heart conditions. It should be used with caution in patients mild to moderate heart problems.
Drotaverine injections are suitable for use in children.
DROTIN INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients, especially with pre-existing illnesses.

Others

DROTIN INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients suffering from:

Stomach ulcers or inflammation
Porphyria

name: DOVERIN A Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About DOVERIN A TABLET

DOVERIN A TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use DOVERIN A TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking DOVERIN A TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking DOVERIN A TABLET. The most common side effects of taking DOVERIN A TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of DOVERIN A TABLET

Manages,

Dysmenorrhea
Abdominal pain
Cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How DOVERIN A TABLET Works

DOVERIN A TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use DOVERIN A TABLET

Always take DOVERIN A TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of DOVERIN A TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking DOVERIN A TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

warnings.details: DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women unless considered clearly necessary (especially in last 3 months). Consult your doctor before taking it.
DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience dizziness, spinning sensation, drowsiness, tiredness or any difficulty with your eyesight after taking DOVERIN A TABLET.
DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe kidney disease.
DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who have or suspect they have severe liver failure.
Do not take DOVERIN A TABLET if you are allergic to Aceclofenac, Drotaverine, aspirin, any other NSAIDs (Ex. ibuprofen, naproxen or diclofenac) or any of the other ingredients of this medicine.
DOVERIN A TABLET should be used with caution in patients having asthma or any other breathing problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in patients having heart diseases like heart attack and cerebrovascular diseases like stroke or mini stroke or those who have undergone a surgery to clear or bypass blockages.

Others

DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Had, have or suspect that you have a stomach ulcer
Have vomited blood or passed black tarry stools
Have blood circulation problems
Have bleeding or blood clotting disorders
Glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

Before taking DOVERIN A TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have stomach or bowel disorders (Ex. ulcerative colitis, Crohn’s disease, ulceration, bleeding or holes in the stomach or bowel)
Have or had blood circulation problems to your brain
Have porphyria (rare genetic disorder)
Smoke
Have diabetes
Have systemic lupus erythematosus (an autoimmune condition)
Have connective tissue disorders
Have chicken pox
Are recovering from any major surgery

Use in paediatrics:

DOVERIN A TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (below 18 years of age). Consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Use in geriatrics:

DOVERIN A TABLET should be used with caution in elderly people. Consult your doctor before taking it.

interactions:
Interactions

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking DOVERIN A TABLET, inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Medicines used for mental health problems (Ex. fluoxetine, fluvoxamine, citalopram, escitalopram, paroxetine, sertraline, lithium)
Medicines used to manage heart failure, irregular heartbeats, high blood pressure and other heart problems (Ex. digoxin, enalapril, lisinopril, losartan, candesartan, hydralazine, methyldopa, clonidine, moxonidine, propranolol, quinidine, procainamide)
Medicines used to manage infection (ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, levofloxacin, moxifloxacin)
Medicines used to manage fluid retention (Ex. hydrochlorothiazide, furosemide, amiloride)
Medicines that stop blood clotting (Ex. warfarin, heparin)
Methotrexate (used to manage cancer and autoimmune disorders like arthritis and skin conditions)
Mifepristone (used to terminate pregnancy)
Medicines used to manage swelling and inflammation (Ex. hydrocortisone, prednisolone)
Medicines used to suppress the immune system after transplant (Ex. ciclosporin, tacrolimus)
Zidovudine (used to manage HIV)
Medicines used to reduce blood sugar levels in diabetes (Ex. glibenclamide, gliclazide, tolbutamide)
Other medicines used to reduce pain (Ex. aspirin, ibuprofen, naproxen, celecoxib, etoricoxib)
Clopidogrel (used to dissolve blood clots)
Phenobarbital (used to control fits)
Levodopa (used in Parkinsons’ management)
Morphine (used to manage severe pain)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally took too much of DOVERIN A TABLET, consult your doctor immediately. Symptoms of DOVERIN A TABLET overdose include heart problems or paralysis of breathing center.

name: Cyclopam Injection 5X2ml
introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION contains a medicine called Dicyclomine, which belongs to the Antispasmodics. It is used to manage functional bowel syndrome or irritable bowel syndrome. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common condition that affects the digestive system. It causes symptoms like stomach cramps, bloating, diarrhoea, and constipation.

Before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver, lungs, or heart or if you have other conditions such as myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, or reflux esophagitis. CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if advised by your doctor.

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women or children less than 6 months of age. In elderly patients (over the age of 65), CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution. The most common side effects associated with the use of CYCLOPAM INJECTION include dizziness, weakness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, sleepiness, and nervousness. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYCLOPAM INJECTION
Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOPAM INJECTION Works

CYCLOPAM INJECTION works by slowing the natural movements of the gut and by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and intestine, which helps to relieve cramps, pain, bloating, wind, and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION will be administered intramuscularly to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital setting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if considered necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness or blurred vision after receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney diseases. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver disease. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
Do not receive CYCLOPAM INJECTION if you are allergic to Dicyclomine.

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage. It should be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure, coronary heart disease, high blood pressure and with a history of cardiac surgery. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.

Others

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use, if you have:

Glaucoma
Myasthenia gravis

introduction:
Introduction About DROTIGO DS TABLET

DROTIGO DS TABLET is an antispasmodic agent used to provide relief from painful conditions such as menstrual pain, abdominal pain or any other pain related to smooth muscle. It is also used in the pain management of functional bowel disorders and alleviating pain in renal colic.

It contains a medicine called Drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles. Take this medicine as directed by your physician. Avoid misuse of drotaverine without medical consultation as it could lead to stomach ulcers and inflammation.

Before taking DROTIGO DS TABLET, inform your doctor if you have any pre-existing liver, kidney or heart problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have asthma, allergic rhinitis, stomach ulcers or inflammation or if you are pregnant or breastfeeding as a precaution.

The most common side effects of taking this medicine are dry mouth, dizziness, headache and irregular pulse rate. Consult your doctor if they trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How DROTIGO DS TABLET Works

DROTIGO DS TABLET contains a medicine called drotaverine which works by relaxing the smooth muscles in the body, especially those in the digestive and urinary systems. It does this by blocking an enzyme called phosphodiesterase (PDE-4), which leads to an increase in certain molecules that help muscles relax. This action helps to relieve pain and discomfort caused by muscle spasms, like those experienced in conditions such as cramps, stomach pain, or menstrual pain.

introduction:
Introduction About LIBRAX TABLET

LIBRAX TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

LIBRAX TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

LIBRAX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking LIBRAX TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

Acute enterocolitis
mechanismOfAction:
How LIBRAX TABLET Works

LIBRAX TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use LIBRAX TABLET

Take LIBRAX TABLET as advised by your physician. It should be taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)

Have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon and rectum)
Have psychotic disorders

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have eye problems
Have coordination problems
Have bleeding problems

Have memory problems

Have fits
Have lactose intolerance

The safety and effectiveness of LIBRAX TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.

name: NORMAXIN Tablet 20's
introduction:
Introduction About NORMAXIN TABLET

NORMAXIN TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

NORMAXIN TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking NORMAXIN TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take NORMAXIN TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NORMAXIN TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage painful stomach cramps associated irritable bowel syndrome, colitis or peptic ulcers
Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)
usesDetails:

Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)
mechanismOfAction:
How NORMAXIN TABLET Works

NORMAXIN TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.
usageDetails:
How to use NORMAXIN TABLET

Take NORMAXIN TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NORMAXIN TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

The most common side effects of taking MEVA C CAPSULE are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, loss of balance, poor muscle control, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. usesDetails:
Uses Of DVN FORTE TABLET

It is used to manage and relieve pain due to:

Irritable bowel syndrome
Menstrual periods

It also manages spasm or twitches of the smooth muscles in the stomach and heart.
mechanismOfAction:
How DVN FORTE TABLET Works

DVN FORTE TABLET helps to manage pain, where Drotaverine works by inhibiting phosphodiesterase 4 (an enzyme responsible for the degradation of cyclic adenosine monophosphate CAMP), inhibition of PDE4 leads to elevated levels of CAMP and reduced calcium uptake by the cells, leading to smooth muscle relaxation. Paracetamol relieves pain by reducing the production of prostaglandins in the brain and spinal cord. Prostaglandins are produced by the body in response to injury and certain diseases.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET

CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage painful stomach cramps associated irritable bowel syndrome, colitis or peptic ulcers
Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)

Uses Of CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET
Manage painful stomach cramps associated irritable bowel syndrome, colitis or peptic ulcers
Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET Works

CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET

Take CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CYCLOBID PLUS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About LIBRAX TABLET

LIBRAX TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

LIBRAX TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

LIBRAX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking LIBRAX TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIBRAX TABLET Works

LIBRAX TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LIBRAX TABLET because it may worsen sleepiness and dizziness.

Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)

Have intestinal obstruction
Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)

Have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon and rectum)
Have psychotic disorders

Have coordination problems
Have bleeding problems

Have memory problems

Have fits
Have lactose intolerance

The safety and effectiveness of LIBRAX TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

LIBRAX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.
