name: ELSPAS C Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About ELSPAS C TABLET

ELSPAS C TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

ELSPAS C TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking ELSPAS C TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take ELSPAS C TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ELSPAS C TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.
uses: Manage painful stomach cramps associated irritable bowel syndrome, colitis or peptic ulcers
Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)
usesDetails:
Uses Of ELSPAS C TABLET
Manage painful stomach cramps associated irritable bowel syndrome, colitis or peptic ulcers
Manage nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness)
mechanismOfAction:
How ELSPAS C TABLET Works

ELSPAS C TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.
usageDetails:
How to use ELSPAS C TABLET

Take ELSPAS C TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ELSPAS C TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the lips, face or body and difficulty in breathing or swallowing)

Common

Irregular menstrual cycles
Rare

Stop taking ELSPAS C TABLET and inform your doctor immediately if you experience any of the following side effects such as:

Severe allergic reactions (such as skin rash, itching, swelling of the lips, face or body and difficulty in breathing or swallowing)
Slow or difficult speech, shuffling walk
Persistent tremor or inability to sit still
Yellowing of the skin or eyes

warnings.details: ELSPAS C TABLET should be used in pregnant women only if it is considered necessary by the physician. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ELSPAS C TABLET may reduce breast milk production. Therefore, it is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by the physician.
ELSPAS C TABLET may induce drowsiness. Therefore, do not drive or handle heavy tools or machines if your ability is affected by ELSPAS C TABLET.
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking ELSPAS C TABLET, as it could make you feel more dizzy or drowsy.
ELSPAS C TABLET should be used with caution in patients with kidney problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ELSPAS C TABLET should be used with caution in patients with liver problems. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take ELSPAS C TABLET if you are allergic to Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine.
ELSPAS C TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (aged below 18 years) due to lack of safety data. Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.
ELSPAS C TABLET is generally not recommended for use in the elderly patients (aged 65 years and above). Therefore, consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

Before taking ELSPAS C TABLET inform your doctor if you:

Have glaucoma
Have prostate enlargement
Have problems in passing urine due to block in the neck of the bladder
Have any vision problems
Have any urinary problems
Have hiatus hernia (abnormal bulging of stomach contents)

introduction:
Introduction About ZEPOX CD TABLET

ZEPOX CD TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

ZEPOX CD TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking ZEPOX CD TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take ZEPOX CD TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ZEPOX CD TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ZEPOX CD TABLET Works

ZEPOX CD TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.
usageDetails:
How to use ZEPOX CD TABLET

Take ZEPOX CD TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ZEPOX CD TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

The most common side effects of taking MYCOLON C TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, loss of balance, poor muscle control, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

A. Drug-Drug interactions:

Before taking MYCOLON C TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines such as:

Medicines used to manage psychiatric disorders (such as pimozide, haloperidol, risperidone, thioridazine, fluphenazine, chlorpromazine, clozapine) or selegiline
Medicine used to manage depression like monoamine oxidase inhibitors (Ex. tranylcypromine, moclobemide iproniazid, nialamide, isocarboxazid, toloxatone)
Medicines that reduce anxiety and induces sleep (Ex. diazepam, clonazepam, lorazepam, midazolam)
Medicines used for pain relief (such as tramadol, ibuprofen)
Anesthetics (medicines causing loss of sensation or consciousness) such as sevoflurane, propofol, etc.
Medicines used to manage allergic conditions (such as chlorphenamine)
Medicines used to manage fits (such as phenytoin and phenobarbital)
Rifampicin (an antibiotic used in the management of Tuberculosis)
Cimetidine, omeprazole (medicines used for stomach ulcers)
Medicines used to manage bacterial infections (such as erythromycin)
Disulfiram (a medicine used to quit alcoholism)
Contraceptive agents (birth control pills) Ex. mifepristone
Medicines used to manage viral infections (Ex. ritonavir)
Medicines used to manage high blood pressure (such as atenolol, propranolol, moxonidine)
Medicines used to manage blood clots (such as heparin, warfarin)
Cardiac glycosides (such as digoxin) used to manage abnormal heart rhythm
Levodopa (a medicine used to manage parkinsonism)
Sodium oxybate (a medicine used to manage narcolepsy)
Theophylline (a medicine used to manage asthma)
Opioids (medicines used for pain relief) such as morphine, codeine, pethidine, fentanyl

B. Drug-Food interaction:

Try to take this medicine before or with meals to achieve maximum efficacy.

If you or anyone else accidentally took more MYCOLON C TABLET, contact your doctor immediately or go to a hospital straight away.

name: Equirex Tablet 10'S
introduction:
Introduction About EQUIREX TABLET

EQUIREX TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

EQUIREX TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

EQUIREX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EQUIREX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking EQUIREX TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.
usesDetails:
Uses Of EQUIREX TABLET

Manage:

Peptic ulcer
Irritable bowel syndrome
Acute enterocolitis
mechanismOfAction:
How EQUIREX TABLET Works

EQUIREX TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use EQUIREX TABLET

Take EQUIREX TABLET as advised by your physician. It should be taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially during the first trimester as it may cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EQUIREX TABLET should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary as it may pass through your breast milk and may cause sedation in infants. Talk to your doctor about the best way to feed your baby if you take this medicine. EQUIREX TABLET may decrease the amount of breast milk your body makes.
EQUIREX TABLET may cause sleepiness or dizziness and can slow your thinking and motor
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking EQUIREX TABLET because it may worsen sleepiness and dizziness.
EQUIREX TABLET should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before taking it.
EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take EQUIREX TABLET if you are allergic to Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium or any other ingredients of this medicine.
EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe respiratory insufficiency (breathing problems). Contact your doctor before taking it.
EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiovascular instability. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

EQUIREX TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have history of drug abuse or dependence
Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)
Have hiatal hernia with (a condition where the top of your stomach bulges through an opening in your diaphragm) with acid reflux
Have intestinal obstruction
Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)
Have benign bladder neck obstruction (blockage of bladder causing problems with urination)
Have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon and rectum)
Have psychotic disorders

Before taking EQUIREX TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have eye problems
Have coordination problems
Have bleeding problems
Have xerostomia (dry mouth)
Have memory problems
Have impaired thinking, confusion or any other type of brain damage
Have fits
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of EQUIREX TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

EQUIREX TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About CIZASPA X TABLET

CIZASPA X TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used in the management of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) and other digestive problems caused due to excessive stress such as peptic ulcer, Crohn’s disease and Colitis.

It helps in relieving painful stomach cramps, bloating, indigestion and other symptoms of IBS and also reduces the excessive tension and anxiety associated with IBS. CIZASPA X TABLET preferably taken before or with meals.

During the management, follow a fiber-rich diet and drink plenty of water as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Restrict the foods that does not suits your gut. If you find that certain foods increase your symptoms, then it makes sense not to eat them.

Before taking CIZASPA X TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing problems, muscle problems, mental illnesses, or an habit of drug abuse or chronic alcoholism as a precaution.

Do not take CIZASPA X TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CIZASPA X TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, loss of balance, poor muscle control, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIZASPA X TABLET Works

CIZASPA X TABLET contains two medicines namely chlordiazepoxide and mebeverine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of anxiety caused due to IBS.

Mebeverine is a smooth muscle relaxant. It reduces stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with IBS.
usageDetails:
How to use CIZASPA X TABLET

Take CIZASPA X TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before or with meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking CIZASPA X TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About EBIRAX 5MG TABLET

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking EBIRAX 5MG TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How EBIRAX 5MG TABLET Works

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use EBIRAX 5MG TABLET

Take EBIRAX 5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It should be taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have intestinal obstruction
Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)

Have psychotic disorders

Have bleeding problems

Have fits

The safety and effectiveness of EBIRAX 5MG TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

EBIRAX 5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Introduction About CIZASPA X TABLET

CIZASPA X TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used in the management of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) and other digestive problems caused due to excessive stress such as peptic ulcer, Crohn’s disease and Colitis.

It helps in relieving painful stomach cramps, bloating, indigestion and other symptoms of IBS and also reduces the excessive tension and anxiety associated with IBS. CIZASPA X TABLET preferably taken before or with meals.

During the management, follow a fiber-rich diet and drink plenty of water as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Restrict the foods that does not suits your gut. If you find that certain foods increase your symptoms, then it makes sense not to eat them.

Before taking CIZASPA X TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing problems, muscle problems, mental illnesses, or an habit of drug abuse or chronic alcoholism as a precaution.

Do not take CIZASPA X TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CIZASPA X TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, loss of balance, poor muscle control, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIZASPA X TABLET Works

CIZASPA X TABLET contains two medicines namely chlordiazepoxide and mebeverine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of anxiety caused due to IBS.

Mebeverine is a smooth muscle relaxant. It reduces stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with IBS.

KR U TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

KR U TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking KR U TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take KR U TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking KR U TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How KR U TABLET Works

KR U TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION contains a medicine called Dicyclomine, which belongs to the Antispasmodics. It is used to manage functional bowel syndrome or irritable bowel syndrome. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common condition that affects the digestive system. It causes symptoms like stomach cramps, bloating, diarrhoea, and constipation.

Before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver, lungs, or heart or if you have other conditions such as myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, or reflux esophagitis. CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if advised by your doctor.

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women or children less than 6 months of age. In elderly patients (over the age of 65), CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution. The most common side effects associated with the use of CYCLOPAM INJECTION include dizziness, weakness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, sleepiness, and nervousness. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.

Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOPAM INJECTION Works

CYCLOPAM INJECTION works by slowing the natural movements of the gut and by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and intestine, which helps to relieve cramps, pain, bloating, wind, and discomfort.

How to use CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION will be administered intramuscularly to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital setting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if considered necessary. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
Do not drive or operate any machines if you experience drowsiness, dizziness or blurred vision after receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from kidney diseases. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution in patients suffering from liver disease. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.
Do not receive CYCLOPAM INJECTION if you are allergic to Dicyclomine.

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with unstable cardiovascular status in acute haemorrhage. It should be used with caution in patients with congestive heart failure, coronary heart disease, high blood pressure and with a history of cardiac surgery. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.

Others

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use, if you have:

Glaucoma
Myasthenia gravis
Severe ulcerative colitis
Obstructive uropathy (flow of urine is blocked)
Obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, reflux esophagitis

Before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have:

Ulcerative colitis
Enlarged prostate
Autonomic neuropathy (damage to the nerve that controls body functions such as temperature, blood pressure, and digestion)
Fever

Use in pediatrics:

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use in children less than 6 months of age. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.   

Use in geriatrics:

CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution in elderly patients (above 65 years of age). Usually, the dose will be initiated with the lowest effective dose depending upon kidney function. Consult your doctor before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION.

introduction:
Introduction About VETORY D TABLET

VETORY D TABLET is a combination of Aceclofenac and Drotaverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics. It is used to manage dysmenorrhea (menstrual pain), abdominal pain and cramps.

Do not use VETORY D TABLET if you are allergic to other NSAIDs like ibuprofen or aspirin. Before taking VETORY D TABLET, inform your doctor if you have a history of stomach ulcer, have vomited blood, passed blood in faeces, have any kidney, heart, liver, bowel or blood clotting problems, porphyria, diabetes, chicken pox or if you have undergone any bypass surgery.

VETORY D TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women unless considered necessary by your doctor. VETORY D TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents (under 18 years of age) so, consult your child’s doctor for advice.

Avoid smoking while taking VETORY D TABLET. The most common side effects of taking VETORY D TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, nausea, sleepiness, blurred vision and weakness. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen over time.
usesDetails:
Uses Of VETORY D TABLET

Manages,

Dysmenorrhea
Abdominal pain
Cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How VETORY D TABLET Works

VETORY D TABLET relieves abdominal pain and cramps where Drotaverine relieves contractions in the abdomen by inhibiting phosphodiesterase-IV (a substance specific for smooth muscles) and Aceclofenac blocks the release of prostaglandins (certain chemicals) responsible for causing pain and inflammation.
usageDetails:
How to use VETORY D TABLET

Always take VETORY D TABLET as directed by your physician. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water and do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of VETORY D TABLET management depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking VETORY D TABLET unless your doctor advises you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About TRIGAN D TABLET

TRIGAN D TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking TRIGAN D TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. TRIGAN D TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

TRIGAN D TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

TRIGAN D TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. TRIGAN D TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. TRIGAN D TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. TRIGAN D TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking TRIGAN D TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

introduction:
Introduction About NORMAXIN TABLET

NORMAXIN TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

NORMAXIN TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking NORMAXIN TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take NORMAXIN TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking NORMAXIN TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How NORMAXIN TABLET Works

NORMAXIN TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.

Take NORMAXIN TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking NORMAXIN TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

usesDetails:
Uses Of MEBIZID SPAS TABLET

It is used in the management of:

Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS; painful stomach cramps, bloating, indigestion)
Peptic ulcer, Crohn’s disease or Colitis
Excessive tension and anxiety associated with IBS
mechanismOfAction:
How MEBIZID SPAS TABLET Works

MEBIZID SPAS TABLET contains two medicines namely chlordiazepoxide and mebeverine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of anxiety caused due to IBS.

Mebeverine is a smooth muscle relaxant. It reduces stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with IBS.
usageDetails:
How to use MEBIZID SPAS TABLET

Take MEBIZID SPAS TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before or with meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking MEBIZID SPAS TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

introduction:
Introduction About LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET Works

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.
usageDetails:
How to use LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET

Take LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET as advised by your physician. It should be taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

warnings.details: LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women especially during the first trimester as it may cause harm to the unborn baby. Consult your doctor before taking it.

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary as it may pass through your breast milk and may cause sedation in infants. Talk to your doctor about the best way to feed your baby if you take this medicine. LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET may decrease the amount of breast milk your body makes.
LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET may cause sleepiness or dizziness and can slow your thinking and motor
Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET because it may worsen sleepiness and dizziness.
LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in patients with impaired kidney function. Consult your doctor before taking it.
LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease. Consult your doctor before taking it.
Do not take LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET if you are allergic to Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium or any other ingredients of this medicine.
LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with severe respiratory insufficiency (breathing problems). Contact your doctor before taking it.
LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with cardiovascular instability. Consult your doctor before taking it.

Others

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET is not recommended for use if you:

Have history of drug abuse or dependence
Have glaucoma (increased eye pressure)
Have hiatal hernia with (a condition where the top of your stomach bulges through an opening in your diaphragm) with acid reflux
Have intestinal obstruction
Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)
Have benign bladder neck obstruction (blockage of bladder causing problems with urination)
Have ulcerative colitis (inflammation of colon and rectum)
Have psychotic disorders

Before taking LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET, inform your doctor if you:

Have hyperthyroidism (overactive thyroid)
Have eye problems
Have coordination problems
Have bleeding problems
Have xerostomia (dry mouth)
Have memory problems
Have impaired thinking, confusion or any other type of brain damage
Have fits
Have lactose intolerance

Use in paediatrics:

The safety and effectiveness of LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

LIBRAX 2.5/5MG TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE

TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE is used in the management of abdominal pain and tinnitus. It contains Caroverine which belongs to the group of medicines known as Antispasmodic agents. TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE works by blocking specific calcium channels and modifying neurotransmitter release in the nervous system. This helps in reducing abnormal nerve activity that leads to muscle spasms and protects the inner ear's nerve cells.

Before taking TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE, inform your doctor if you have kidney, liver or heart disease. There are limited studies available for pregnant and breastfeeding women. TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE can be taken with or without food, though taking it with food may reduce gastrointestinal side effects.

The most common side effects of TINNEX 20MG CAPSULE are drowsiness, dizziness, nausea, upset stomach or rash, itching, or swelling (allergic reactions). Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About CIBIS TABLET

CIBIS TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide, Clidinium and Dicyclomine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used to relieve painful stomach cramps in patients suffering from stomach problems such as peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome or colitis.

It also helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia (signs of indigestion associated with anxiety and nervousness) in patients with or without any mental disorders.

CIBIS TABLET should be used under medical supervision. It is preferably taken before meals and at bedtime. Before taking CIBIS TABLET inform your doctor if you have any liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, trouble urination or any vision problems as a precaution.

Do not take CIBIS TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking CIBIS TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, dry mouth, thirst, dry skin, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How CIBIS TABLET Works

CIBIS TABLET contains three medicines namely chlordiazepoxide, clidinium and dicyclomine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of nervous dyspepsia.

Clidinium and dicyclomine are smooth muscle relaxants. They reduce stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with indigestion.

introduction:
Introduction About MORFEN PLUS TABLET

MORFEN PLUS TABLET is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is used to manage fever. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain, such as headaches, toothaches, joint or muscle pains, and period pain.

MORFEN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, kidney or liver disease, or heart failure. Contact your doctor before taking.

Pregnant women should generally avoid using MORFEN PLUS TABLET. Contact your doctor before taking.

MORFEN PLUS TABLET is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

MORFEN PLUS TABLET is not recommended for use in children. Contact your doctor before taking.

MORFEN PLUS TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the above side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How MORFEN PLUS TABLET Works

MORFEN PLUS TABLET helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

Take MORFEN PLUS TABLET as advised by your physician. It can be taken with or without food.

For Tablet, Capsule: Swallow MORFEN PLUS TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse the medicine in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the medicine immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SPASRIL TABLET

SPASRIL TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium which belongs to the group of medicines called Benzodiazepine and Anticholinergic respectively. It is used to manage emotional and somatic factors (anxiety and depression) in gastrointestinal disorders.

SPASRIL TABLET is used with other medicines for the management of peptic ulcer (sores on the lining of the stomach or intestine), irritable bowel syndrome (an intestinal disorder that causes abdominal pain, gas, diarrhea and constipation) and acute enterocolitis (inflammation of intestines).

SPASRIL TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

SPASRIL TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

SPASRIL TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

SPASRIL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking SPASRIL TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How SPASRIL TABLET Works

SPASRIL TABLET contains Chlordiazepoxide and Clidinium. Chlordiazepoxide is a benzodiazepine which affects chemical activity in your brain to help promote sleep and to reduce anxiety and worry and Clidinium bromide works by slowing down the natural movements of your stomach and lower intestine to relieve stomach pain or discomfort. This helps to manage peptic ulcers, irritable bowel syndrome and acute entero-colitis effectively.

Take SPASRIL TABLET as advised by your physician. It should be taken before meals and at bedtime. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.

Have intestinal obstruction
Have myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness)
Have prostatic hypertrophy (enlarged prostate gland)

Have fits

The safety and effectiveness of SPASRIL TABLET in children is not established. Contact your doctor before taking it.

Use in geriatrics:

SPASRIL TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients aged 65years and above due to increased risk of drowsiness, ataxia (impaired coordination) and confusion. Consult your doctor before taking it.

introduction:
Introduction About MORFEN SPAS TABLET

MORFEN SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MORFEN SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MORFEN SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MORFEN SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MORFEN SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MORFEN SPAS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MORFEN SPAS TABLET Works

MORFEN SPAS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MORFEN SPAS TABLET

Take MORFEN SPAS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MORFEN SPAS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MORFEN SPAS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

Medicines used to manage clot formation in blood such as anti-platelet drugs (Ex. warfarin, aspirin or clopidogrel)
Diuretics such as furosemide, hydrochlorothiazide (used to manage edema)
Medicines used to reduce acidity (Ex. magnesium hydroxide)
Oral anti-diabetic drugs used for the management of type 2 Diabetes (Ex. glimepiride, gliclazide, glibenclamide)

Medicines that affect gastrointestinal motility (Ex. metoclopramide)
Medicines used to manage pregnancy (abortion) (Ex. mifepristone)

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of MORFEN SPAS TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Symptoms of overdose are lethargy, drowsiness, nausea, headache, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot dry skin, dizziness, dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, vomiting, (upper stomach) epigastric pain, tonic-clonic (grand mal) fits, gastrointestinal bleeding, high blood pressure, acute renal failure, CNS stimulation (increased alertness, attention, energy and physical activity), respiratory depression (slow and ineffective breathing), muscular weakness and paralysis.

NORMAXIN CC TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with liver disease, cardiovascular instability, severe breathing problems and glaucoma. Contact your doctor before taking it.

NORMAXIN CC TABLET should be used with caution in patients with high blood pressure impaired kidney function, fits. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NORMAXIN CC TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women. It should be used in breastfeeding women only if clearly necessary. Consult your doctor before taking it.

NORMAXIN CC TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. Consult your doctor before taking it. The most common side effects of taking NORMAXIN CC TABLET are dry mouth, nausea, constipation, skin problems, blurred vision, swelling, irregular menstrual cycles etc. Consult your doctor if any of the symptoms worsen.

introduction:
Introduction About PARVON SPAS TABLET

PARVON SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used for the management of stomach cramps, renal and biliary colic, as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions. It is also used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS).

Avoid consuming alcohol while taking PARVON SPAS TABLET, as it may increase the side effects. PARVON SPAS TABLET is not recommended in patients with an unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, or reflux esophagitis.

PARVON SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with severe liver and kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (the small intestine partially or totally blocked), patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), hyperthyroidism, alcoholism, and in patients who take painkillers often for headache, etc.

PARVON SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in pregnant women, unless considered necessary. PARVON SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women. PARVON SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use by children under 10 years of age. PARVON SPAS TABLET should be used with caution by elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking PARVON SPAS TABLET are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation, and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms get worse.

How PARVON SPAS TABLET Works

It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

introduction:
Introduction About STYNAC SPAS TABLET

STYNAC SPAS TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

STYNAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). STYNAC SPAS TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

STYNAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. STYNAC SPAS TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking STYNAC SPAS TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

Abdominal pain

mechanismOfAction:
How STYNAC SPAS TABLET Works

STYNAC SPAS TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use STYNAC SPAS TABLET

Take STYNAC SPAS TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of STYNAC SPAS TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of STYNAC SPAS TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About ULCON MV TABLET

ULCON MV TABLET is a combination of Chlordiazepoxide and Mebeverine which belongs to the group of medicines called Antianxiety drugs and Antispasmodics respectively. It is used in the management of Irritable Bowel Syndrome (IBS) and other digestive problems caused due to excessive stress such as peptic ulcer, Crohn’s disease and Colitis.

It helps in relieving painful stomach cramps, bloating, indigestion and other symptoms of IBS and also reduces the excessive tension and anxiety associated with IBS. ULCON MV TABLET preferably taken before or with meals.

During the management, follow a fiber-rich diet and drink plenty of water as instructed by your doctor to achieve better results. Restrict the foods that does not suits your gut. If you find that certain foods increase your symptoms, then it makes sense not to eat them.

Before taking ULCON MV TABLET inform your doctor if you have any lung, liver or kidney problems. You must also inform your doctor if you have any breathing problems, muscle problems, mental illnesses, or an habit of drug abuse or chronic alcoholism as a precaution.

Do not take ULCON MV TABLET without consulting your doctor if you are pregnant or breastfeeding. The most common side effects of taking ULCON MV TABLET are tiredness, weakness, headache, dizziness, sleepiness, loss of balance, poor muscle control, problems in passing urine, reduced sex drive and irregular periods. Consult your doctor if any of these side effects trouble you.

mechanismOfAction:
How ULCON MV TABLET Works

ULCON MV TABLET contains two medicines namely chlordiazepoxide and mebeverine. Chlordiazepoxide is an antianxiety medication. It suppresses the abnormal electrical activity within the brain and induces calmness. This helps in the management of anxiety caused due to IBS.

Mebeverine is a smooth muscle relaxant. It reduces stomach cramps by relaxing the smooth muscles present in the stomach and in the intestines. Collectively, these actions reduce stomach cramps, signs of indigestion and nervousness associated with IBS.
usageDetails:
How to use ULCON MV TABLET

Take ULCON MV TABLET as advised by your physician. It is preferably taken before or with meals. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Do not stop taking ULCON MV TABLET unless your doctor advice you to stop.

Introduction About MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET

MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET contains Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. It is used to relieve the symptoms of inflammation such as redness and swelling. It can be used to manage pain and discomfort caused due to arthritis (inflammation of joints) muscular diseases or rheumatoid disorders (inflammatory disorders affecting the muscles and joints). It can also be used in the management of headache, muscle pain, tooth ache, post operative pain, childbirth pain, fever in children and painful or heavy periods.

Your doctor may monitor your kidney or liver function before and during the management to make sure they are functioning properly. Your doctor may also suggest you perform blood tests during the management to check your health condition.

MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended for use in patients have or ever had stomach or intestinal conditions such as stomach ulcer, bleeding in the stomach, severe gastritis (inflammation of lining of the stomach) and inflammatory diseases of the intestine such as ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET as it may increase your risk of stomach bleeding.

MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended in patients having severe kidney, liver and heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women particularly in the last 3 months of pregnancy as this may delay the onset of labour and prolong its duration It is not recommended among breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET is not recommended in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged over 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of MEFZEST DT 100 DISPERSIBLE TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your physician if any of the side effects bothers you.

introduction:
Introduction About MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET contains Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs. It is used to relieve the symptoms of inflammation such as redness and swelling. It can be used to manage pain and discomfort caused due to arthritis (inflammation of joints) muscular diseases or rheumatoid disorders (inflammatory disorders affecting the muscles and joints). It can also be used in the management of headache, muscle pain, tooth ache, post operative pain, childbirth pain, fever in children and painful or heavy periods.

Your doctor may monitor your kidney or liver function before and during the management to make sure they are functioning properly. Your doctor may also suggest you perform blood tests during the management to check your health condition.

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET is not recommended for use in patients have or ever had stomach or intestinal conditions such as stomach ulcer, bleeding in the stomach, severe gastritis (inflammation of lining of the stomach) and inflammatory diseases of the intestine such as ulcerative colitis or Crohn’s disease.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET as it may increase your risk of stomach bleeding.

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET is not recommended in patients having severe kidney, liver and heart problems. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET is not recommended for use in pregnant women particularly in the last 3 months of pregnancy as this may delay the onset of labour and prolong its duration It is not recommended among breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Consult your doctor before taking it.

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET is not recommended in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged over 65 years). Consult your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET are abdominal pain, nausea, vomiting, diarrhoea and constipation. Consult your physician if any of the side effects bothers you.

mechanismOfAction:
How MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET Works

MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET works by binding to certain receptors in the body where it blocks the action of a particular chemical called prostaglandins in the body. Thus, it relieves pain, redness and swelling associated with various inflammatory conditions of the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET

Always take MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET as advised by your physician.

For Tablet: Swallow MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine.

For Dispersible Tablet: Disperse MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET in the specified quantity of water as mentioned in the label. Consume the mixture immediately after reconstitution.

Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition. Continue to take MEFZOX 100 DT TABLET for the stipulated duration prescribed by your doctor to achieve better results.

name: ANTISPAS Drops 10ml
introduction:
Introduction About ANTISPAS DROPS

ANTISPAS DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Dimethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodic agents and Anti-foaming agents respectively. It is used for the management of functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome, gastric distension, functional digestive disorders and stomach pain in children.

Before giving ANTISPAS DROPS inform your doctor if your child have diarrhea, ulcerative colitis, thyroid problems, hypertension, liver problems, kidney problems or heart problems, history of allergy, intolerance to any food products and abdominal obstruction.

Your doctor will decide the right dose depends on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition. ANTISPAS DROPS may cause your child to sweat less, increasing his or her risk of heatstroke. Avoid overheating by avoiding strenuous work or exercise in hot weather and using hot baths.

Give the prescribed dose to your child orally before a meal or as directed by the doctor. Do not abruptly stop the medicine by yourself as it may bring back the symptoms or worsen your child’s condition.

The most common side effects of this medicine are dryness in the mouth, dizziness, weakness, sleepiness, nervousness, blurred vision and nausea. Contact your physician if any of the above symptoms worsen or persists for a longer duration.

If these side effects occur, they will subside once your child’s body adapts to the medicine. In case these side effects do not improve or become bothersome for your child, contact your doctor immediately.
usesDetails:
Uses Of ANTISPAS DROPS

It is used to manage:

Functional bowel/irritable bowel syndrome
Gastric distension
Functional digestive disorders
Stomach pain
mechanismOfAction:
How ANTISPAS DROPS Works

ANTISPAS DROPS is a combination of Dicyclomine and Dimethicone. Dicyclomine works by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and gut (intestine). It stops sudden contractions of the muscle (spasms), thereby relieving abdominal cramps and pain. Dimethicone works by disintegrating the gas bubbles and allowing easy passage of gas. Hence it helps to reduce the abdominal pain caused due to cramps, spasms and gas formation.
usageDetails:
How to use ANTISPAS DROPS

Give ANTISPAS DROPS to your child as advised by your physician. Shake well before use. Your physician will decide the correct dose and duration depending on your child’s age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About COLIGON O TABLET

COLIGON O TABLET contains a combination of Dicyclomine, Magaldrate, Oxetacaine and Simethicone which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Antacid, Local anaesthetic, and Antiflatulents respectively. It is used for the symptomatic relief of gastro-oesophageal reflux disease, pain relief and counter acidity.

Avoid alcohol consumption while taking COLIGON O TABLET as it may cause drowsiness. COLIGON O TABLET is not recommended in patients with unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis.

COLIGON O TABLET should be used with caution in patients with lung disease such as COPD, liver and kidney disease, tachyarrhythmia, hypertension, coronary heart disease, mitral stenosis, congestive heart failure and in cardiac surgery, or mental illness.

Also inform your doctor if you have incomplete intestinal obstruction, salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), low magnesium level, alzheimer's dementia, severe constipation or diarrhoea, stomach ulcer or intestinal bleeding.

COLIGON O TABLET should be used in pregnancy only if clearly needed. COLIGON O TABLET is not recommended in breastfeeding women, as it may pass through the breast milk. COLIGON O TABLET is not recommended for use in infants less than 6 months of age. COLIGON O TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients. The most common side effects of taking COLIGON O TABLET are dizziness, dry mouth, vision blurred, nausea, or stomach pain. Consult your physician if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How COLIGON O TABLET Works

COLIGON O TABLET is used to manage gastrointestinal muscle spasms where Dicyclomine is an Antispasmodic that works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). Thus, reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Magaldrate is an Antacid, neutralises the excess stomach acid. Oxetacaine is a topical anaesthetic that promotes quicker pain relief for stomach ulcers or other acid-related injuries. Simethicone is an antifoaming medication that breaks down gas bubbles and promotes easy gas passage.

A. Drug - Drug interactions:

Before taking COLIGON O TABLET inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

Antibiotics Ex. such as demeclocycline, doxycycline, minocycline, or tetracycline and ciprofloxacin, ofloxacin, norfloxacin, levofloxacin, lomefloxacin, and methenamine (medicines used for bacterial infection)

Overdosage:

If you or anyone else accidentally takes too much of COLIGON O TABLET, consult your doctor immediately or visit the nearby hospital. Signs and symptoms of overdose may include headache, nausea, vomiting, blurred vision, dilated pupils, hot, dry skin, dizziness, weakness or loss of movement in any part of your body, fainting dryness of the mouth, difficulty in swallowing, and CNS stimulation including convulsion, muscular weakness and possible paralysis.

name: MECYCLOF 10/250 Tablet 10's
introduction:
Introduction About MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET

MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET is a combination of Dicyclomine and Mefenamic Acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Anticholinergics and Non-Steroidal Anti-Inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used for the management of abdominal (stomach) pain and dysmenorrhea, it is a condition in women who experience severe and frequent cramps and pain during menses.

MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET is not recommended for use in patients with pre-existing renal disease or obstructive uropathy, asthma, increased pressure in eyes (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis (muscle weakness), gastrointestinal conditions like inflammatory bowel disease, severe ulcerative colitis, paralysis of intestine (paralytic ileus), chronic constipation (intestinal atony) and toxic dilatation of intestine (megacolon). MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET should be used with caution in patients with heart diseases (heart failure, high blood pressure), impaired liver function, fluid retention, prior history of ulcer disease or gastro-intestinal bleeding and prostate enlargement.

MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET is not recommended for use in third trimester of pregnancy and should be used with caution in first and second trimester of pregnancy. It is not recommended for use in breastfeeding women. MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET is not recommended for use in infants (below 6 months of age) and it should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years and above) as it increases the risk of gastrointestinal (GI) bleeding and perforation which may be fatal. The common side effects of taking MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET are diarrhea, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain and constipation. Consult your doctor if any of the side effects worsens.

mechanismOfAction:
How MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET Works

MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET contains Dicyclomine and Mefenamic acid. Dicyclomine works by blocking the effects of a chemical called acetylcholine (responsible for causing contraction of muscles) at the acetylcholine-receptor sites along with direct spasmolytic effect upon smooth muscles (musculotropic). This helps to relieve smooth muscle spasm of the intestine, bile duct, ureters and uterus. Mefenamic acid works by inhibiting the enzyme cyclooxygenase (COX) which is responsible for formation of chemical called prostaglandin that is responsible for inflammatory response in the body.
usageDetails:
How to use MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET

Take MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET as advised by your doctor. It must be taken preferably after food. Swallow the medicine with a glass of water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Do not alter or discontinue the daily dose of MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET after feeling better without consulting your doctor. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of MECYCLOF 10/250 TABLET for you depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About SPASMONORM M TABLET

SPASMONORM M TABLET is a combination of Camylofin and Mefenamic acid which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodic and Nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) respectively. It is used to manage renal colic (pain when stone gets stuck in the urinary tract causing painful, bloody, or cloudy urination), biliary colic (pain in the abdomen due to obstruction by stones in bile duct), intestinal colic (cramp like pain in the small or large intestine) and dysmenorrhea (period or menstrual cramps around the abdomen, hips, lower back).

Having a fiber rich diet, keeping yourself hydrated, quitting smoking and alcohol will help in the management process. Prior to the management your doctor might want you to take certain blood tests. Before taking SPASMONORM M TABLET inform your doctor if you have liver, kidney, heart, prostate gland, thyroid gland, lung problems, stomach ulcers, bleeding disorder, diabetes, cholesterol, bowel problems, systemic lupus erythematosus, having a surgery, glaucoma, fever, epilepsy or blood circulation problems.

Avoid consumption of alcohol during management with SPASMONORM M TABLET. It is not recommended for use in pregnant and breastfeeding women. SPASMONORM M TABLET is not recommended for use in children and adolescents below 12 years of age. It should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age. The most common side effects of taking SPASMONORM M TABLET are nausea, vomiting, heartburn, stomach pain and diarrhea. Consult your doctor if any of the above side effects do not improve.
usesDetails:
Uses Of SPASMONORM M TABLET

It is used to manage:

Renal colic
Biliary colic
Intestinal colic
Period cramps
mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMONORM M TABLET Works

SPASMONORM M TABLET works by relieving muscle cramps and pain in which Camylofin relaxes the muscles in the stomach and intestine stopping sudden muscle contractions (spasms). Mefenamic acid inhibits the enzyme cyclo-oxygenase and there by inhibits the synthesis of prostaglandins that cause inflammation (redness and swelling) and pain.
usageDetails:
How to use SPASMONORM M TABLET

Take SPASMONORM M TABLET as advised by your physician. Swallow the medicine with water. Do not crush or chew the medicine. Your doctor will decide the right dose and duration depending upon your age, body weight and disease condition.

SPASMONORM M TABLET is not recommended for use in patients who had a heart bypass surgery, mechanical stenosis and other serious heart problems. SPASMONORM M TABLET should be used with caution in elderly patients above 65 years of age as they are more prone to side effects. If needed dose will be adjusted accordingly. Consult your doctor before taking SPASMONORM M TABLET.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION contains a medicine called Dicyclomine, which belongs to the Antispasmodics. It is used to manage functional bowel syndrome or irritable bowel syndrome. Irritable bowel syndrome (IBS) is a common condition that affects the digestive system. It causes symptoms like stomach cramps, bloating, diarrhoea, and constipation.

Before receiving CYCLOPAM INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have any problems related to the kidney, liver, lungs, or heart or if you have other conditions such as myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, glaucoma, an enlarged prostate, or reflux esophagitis. CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used during pregnancy only if advised by your doctor.

CYCLOPAM INJECTION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women or children less than 6 months of age. In elderly patients (over the age of 65), CYCLOPAM INJECTION should be used with caution. The most common side effects associated with the use of CYCLOPAM INJECTION include dizziness, weakness, dry mouth, blurred vision, nausea, sleepiness, and nervousness. Consult your doctor immediately if any of the symptoms worsen.
uses: Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
usesDetails:
Uses Of CYCLOPAM INJECTION
Manage functional bowel or irritable bowel syndrome
mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOPAM INJECTION Works

CYCLOPAM INJECTION works by slowing the natural movements of the gut and by relaxing the muscles in the stomach and intestine, which helps to relieve cramps, pain, bloating, wind, and discomfort.
usageDetails:
How to use CYCLOPAM INJECTION

CYCLOPAM INJECTION will be administered intramuscularly to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital setting. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration for you depending on your age, body weight and disease condition.
