Introduction About AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION contains a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Antispasmodics. AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION is used to relieve pain, swelling and muscle spasms in the stomach or intestine (such as irritable bowel syndrome etc.), abdominal pain and menstrual cramps (throbbing or cramping pains in the lower apart of the stomach).

Irritable bowel syndrome is a condition causing recurrent stomach pain, spasms of muscles involving the intestine, diarrhea or constipation etc.

Your doctor might want you to take certain diagnostic tests before or while receiving AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION such as liver function test or kidney function test to monitor your liver and kidney functions.

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart, liver or kidney diseases, increased eye pressure (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis, bleeding in the digestive system, intestinal obstruction, urinary obstruction or stomach or intestinal ulcers.

Before receiving AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have lung diseases, porphyria, lupus, dehydration, diabetes, high blood pressure or raised cholesterol level.

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION should be used in pregnant women only if clearly needed and is not recommended for use during last 3 months of pregnancy. AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION is not advised to be used in breast feeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION are dizziness, dry mouth, vision blurred, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo or pain at injection site. Contact your doctor if the any of these symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION Works

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION is a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine. Diclofenac is a Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that works by inhibiting the release cyclooxygenase, a chemical messenger that produces fever, discomfort and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Dicyclomine is an Anticholinergic that decreases and relaxes the abnormal muscle contractions in the stomach and intestine by acting on certain receptors called acetylcholine receptors and directly on smooth muscles.

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a muscle as an intramuscular injection (I.M). Your doctor will decide the dose and frequency of AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION depending on the severity of your existing condition and another comorbidity.

AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart disease such as severe heart failure, block in blood vessels of the heart, heart attack etc. AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION should be used with caution in patients with other heart diseases. Before receiving AQUADOL SPAS INJECTION inform your doctor if you are taking any of the following medicines:

introduction:
Introduction About PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION is a combination of Mefenamic acid and Paracetamol, which belongs to a group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory Drugs (NSAIDs) and Analgesics and Antipyretics. It is indicated for the management of fever in children. It is also used for the management of mild to moderate pain such as headache, toothache, joint or muscle pain, and period pain.

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in patients with asthma or aspirin-sensitive asthma, severe liver, kidney, or heart disease. Contact your doctor before taking.

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in pregnant women. Contact your doctor before taking.

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION is generally not recommended for use in breastfeeding women as it may pass through the breast milk. Contact your doctor before taking it.

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION is not recommended for use in children under 6 months of age. Contact your doctor before taking.

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients (aged 65 years or above). Contact your doctor before taking.

The most common side effects of this medicine are skin rash, nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, constipation, indigestion, flatulence, anorexia, dry mouth, heartburn, peptic ulcers, perforation or GI bleeding, and ulcerative stomatitis. Contact your doctor if any of the side effects worsen.

mechanismOfAction:
How PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION Works

PACINOVA M DS SUSPENSION helps to relieve fever and pain, where paracetamol acts on the hypothalamus (heat regulating center) of the brain, resulting in peripheral vasodilation, sweating, and loss of body heat, and it also increases the pain threshold by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, and mefenamic acid works by inhibiting COX-1 and COX-2 enzymes, which are involved in prostaglandin synthesis (responsible for pain and inflammation).

Take this medicine as advised by your doctor. Shake well before use. Your doctor will decide the correct dose and duration of therapy for you depending upon your age, body weight, and disease condition.

introduction:
Introduction About CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION

CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION is a combination of Dicyclomine, and Paracetamol which belongs to the group of medicines called Antispasmodics, Analgesic and Anti-pyretic respectively. It is used to manage functional bowel disease and irritable bowel syndrome (IBS), intestinal colic, stomach cramps, infantile colic, renal and biliary colic, worm colic, non-specific abdominal pain, spasmodic dysmenorrhea as well as pain from gynaecologic or surgical conditions.

Avoid consumption of alcohol while taking CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION, as it may increase the side effects. CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION is not recommended in patients with unstable cardiovascular condition with acute haemorrhage, myasthenia gravis, glaucoma, obstructive uropathy, obstructive disease of the gastrointestinal tract, severe ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis.

CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION should be used with caution in patients with asthma, liver disease, cirrhosis, kidney disease, hypertension, coronary heart disease, congestive heart failure, and cardiac tachyarrhythmia, psychosis, and delirium (such as elderly patients and/or in patients with mental illness), incomplete intestinal obstruction (small intestine partially or totally blocked).

CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION should be also used with caution in patients with salmonella dysentery, ulcerative colitis (inflammatory bowel disease), prostatic hypertrophy (prostate gland enlargement), autonomic neuropathy (injury to the nerves that regulate automatic body functions), hypothyroidism, hiatal hernia, suffered from alcoholism, malnutrition, arthritis or must take painkillers often, infection, glucose-6-phosphatedehydrogenase deficiency, haemolytic anaemia (breakdown of red blood cells), bleeding problems.

CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION should be used during pregnancy, if considered necessary. CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION is not recommended for use by breastfeeding women and in infants less than 6 months of age. CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION should be used with caution in elderly patients.

The most common side effects of taking CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION are hypersensitivity reactions, dry mouth, upset stomach, vomiting, constipation and gas or bloating. Contact your doctor if any of the symptoms got worse.

mechanismOfAction:
How CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION Works

CYCLOBREX SUSPENSION is an antispasmodic works by relaxing the muscles in your stomach and gut (intestine). It manages unexpected muscular contractions (spasms). It also reduces bloating, pain, cramps, and discomfort. Paracetamol is analgesics and antipyretic as well works by inhibiting both COX-1 and COX-2 enzyme and manages prostaglandin synthesis, thus reliefs pain.

Tell your doctor if you have recently taken any other medicines, including medicines obtained without a prescription, vitamin supplement or herbal products:

Antiglaucoma agents
Other drugs with anticholinergic activity such as amantadine, antiarrhythmic agents of class I (Ex. quinidine), antihistamines, antipsychotic agents (Ex. phenothiazines), benzodiazepines, MAO inhibitors, narcotic analgesics (Ex. meperidine), nitrates and nitrites, tricyclic antidepressants, sympathomimetic drugs, and other medications with anticholinergic effects

introduction:
Introduction About SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION contains a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine, which belongs to the group of medicines called Non-steroidal Anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and Antispasmodics. SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION is used to relieve pain, swelling and muscle spasms in the stomach or intestine (such as irritable bowel syndrome etc.), abdominal pain and menstrual cramps (throbbing or cramping pains in the lower apart of the stomach).

Irritable bowel syndrome is a condition causing recurrent stomach pain, spasms of muscles involving the intestine, diarrhea or constipation etc.

Your doctor might want you to take certain diagnostic tests before or while receiving SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION such as liver function test or kidney function test to monitor your liver and kidney functions.

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION is not recommended for use in patients with heart, liver or kidney diseases, increased eye pressure (glaucoma), myasthenia gravis, ulcerative colitis, reflux esophagitis, bleeding in the digestive system, intestinal obstruction, urinary obstruction or stomach or intestinal ulcers.

Before receiving SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION, inform your doctor if you have lung diseases, porphyria, lupus, dehydration, diabetes, high blood pressure or raised cholesterol level.

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION should be used in pregnant women only if clearly needed and is not recommended for use during last 3 months of pregnancy. SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION is not advised to be used in breast feeding women.

The most common side effects of receiving SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION are dizziness, dry mouth, vision blurred, nausea, headache, dizziness, vertigo or pain at injection site. Contact your doctor if the any of these symptoms worsen or doesn’t improve.

mechanismOfAction:
How SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION Works

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION is a combination of Diclofenac and Dicyclomine. Diclofenac is a Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drug that works by inhibiting the release cyclooxygenase, a chemical messenger that produces fever, discomfort and inflammation in the body (redness and swelling). Dicyclomine is an Anticholinergic that decreases and relaxes the abnormal muscle contractions in the stomach and intestine by acting on certain receptors called acetylcholine receptors and directly on smooth muscles.

How to use SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION will be given to you only by a doctor or a nurse into a muscle as an intramuscular injection (I.M). Your doctor will decide the dose and frequency of SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION depending on the severity of your existing condition and another comorbidity.

Overdosage:

SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION will be administered to you only by a doctor or a nurse in a hospital and so it is unlikely to receive an overdose. However, consult your doctor or nurse if you experience any unusual symptoms while receiving SPASMO PROXYVON FORTE INJECTION such as lethargy, drowsiness/dizziness, nervousness, dryness of mouth, difficulty in swallowing, nausea, vomiting, blurring of vision, stomach pain, muscle weakness, black or tarry stool due to bleeding in the digestive system, etc. Contact your doctor immediately if the symptoms are worsening or persists.
